It offers dairy, fruit juice, and related food products under the Almarai, Joosy Life, Beyti, and Teeba brand names; bakery products under the L'usine and 7 Days brand names; and poultry products under the Alyoum and AlBashayer brand names. The company also engages in the arable and horticulture activities; and provision of infant nutrition products under the Nuralac and Evolac brand names. Almarai Company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Tanmiah Food Company
summary: Tanmiah Food Company is a provider of fresh and processed poultry, animal feed, and other agricultural products. The company operates a fully integrated business model that includes farms, hatcheries, feed mills, and processing plants, distributing its products in Saudi Arabia and other GCC countries.

name: Naqi Water Company
summary: Naqi Water Company, founded in 2014 and based in Unaizah, Saudi Arabia, specializes in the purification and bottling of water. Its operations are structured around two primary divisions: Wholesale and Retail. Beyond its core water business, the company also engages in the wholesale distribution of soft drinks and various juices, alongside the retail provision of diverse beverages through dedicated outlets. Naqi Water serves a broad spectrum of customers, ranging from small and medium-sized businesses like supermarkets and grocery stores, to large-scale retailers such as hypermarkets and direct consumers in households. Additionally, its clientele includes institutional bodies (governmental entities, schools, universities, mosques) and the hospitality sector (hotels and restaurants), as well as agents and distributors.

name: First Milling Co.
summary: Operating within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, First Milling Company manufactures and distributes a comprehensive range of flour and associated products. Its diverse flour selection includes premium grades ideal for confectionery and specialized baking, bakery flour suitable for both traditional Arabic and various Western breads, whole wheat flour for healthier options, superior wheat flour for traditional meals, and specific varieties tailored for pastries and pizza. Beyond flour, the company also supplies an extensive range of animal feed products, such as livestock fattener, and feeds for lambs, horses, pigeons, and dairy cattle. Additionally, First Milling processes wheat into derivative products, primarily bran for animal consumption, alongside edible bran offerings. These offerings are marketed under the brand names Aloula, Naffa'a, and First Mills. Serving a broad clientele, First Milling caters to industrial entities, bakeries, restaurants, catering services, wholesalers, both modern and traditional trade channels, farms, feed distributors, and individual retail customers. Established in 1972, the company maintains its headquarters in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Modern Mills for Food Products Co.
summary: Modern Mills for Food Products Co. operates as a Saudi Arabian enterprise, focusing on the production and distribution of flour and animal feed throughout the Kingdom. The company, which commenced operations in 1982, has its main office situated in Jeddah.

name: Arabian Mills for Food Products
summary: Arabian Mills for Food Products Co. specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse array of wheat and animal feed goods. Its core operations encompass the production and warehousing of flour, various wheat-based byproducts, and different types of feed. The company's product portfolio features flour, a range of wheat derivatives, feed for livestock, specialized poultry feed, and bran. Established in 1977, the firm maintains its principal office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Fourth Milling Co.
summary: Established in Dammam, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, in 2017, Fourth Milling Co. is a key player in the grain processing and distribution sector. The company primarily focuses on the manufacturing, packaging, and commercialization of flour, its derivative products, animal feed, and bran throughout Saudi Arabia. Its operations encompass the milling and packaging of wheat, maize, and barley, alongside the comprehensive processing, milling, and bleaching of rice for rice flour production. Fourth Milling Co. also produces specialized flour and dough tailored for bakeries, in addition to concentrated and general animal fodder. Beyond its production facilities, the company manages retail outlets for animal food and feed. Furthermore, it provides extensive storage solutions, including grain silos, warehouses for flour and agricultural products, and strategic facilities at ports, customs, and free zones. Its commercial reach extends to the wholesale distribution of bakery items and the trade of health-conscious and specialty food products.

name: Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment
summary: Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment primarily focuses on the production and distribution of broiler chickens, marketed under its 'Entaj' brand. Its operations are organized into distinct segments. The Poultry Products division offers a comprehensive range of poultry items, including fresh and frozen whole birds, individual chicken parts, marinated selections, and ready-to-cook meals. These are supplied to supermarkets, various distributors, foodservice establishments, and directly to consumers through online channels, in addition to selling live birds. The Table Eggs segment provides eggs to both household and commercial customers, also leveraging online sales. Its Red Meat Products segment delivers fresh lamb to residential and business clients, accessible through direct sales and online platforms. Furthermore, the Cold Store segment generates revenue by leasing its refrigerated storage facilities to external entities. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the company operates as a subsidiary of Arabian Agricultural Services Co. Ltd.

name: Nofoth Food Products Company
summary: Nofoth Food Products Company, established in 2015 with its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is a diversified enterprise primarily engaged in the production and sale of food items within the Saudi Arabian market. Its extensive bakery line includes maamoul cookies and cakes under the Mamola brand, creamy filled desserts known as Qashtiya, and traditional Middle Eastern fare like stuffed vegetables, kibbeh, and Musakhan via the Anaba label. The company also offers a variety of fried and baked dates with diverse flavors and fillings through its Golden Dates brand, alongside pastries and specialty stuffed dishes under the Pinkish Bite brand. Complementing these are pies, biscuits, an assortment of folk and oriental sweets, and various sugary confections such as caramel, toffee, and nougat. Beyond its core food manufacturing, Nofoth extends its operations to provide light transportation services, engage in the wholesale and export of used oil, and retail nuts, coffee, spices, and perfumes. The company further diversifies its activities by operating restaurants and dry fruit stores, executing automated bread production, offering food service contracting, and managing road transport for temperature-controlled goods.

name: Yanbu National Petrochemical Company
summary: Yanbu National Petrochemical Company manufactures and sells petrochemical products in Saudi Arabia. It provides ethylene, propylene, mono ethylene glycol, di ethylene glycol, tri ethylene glycol, polypropylene, low linear density polyethylene, high density polyethylene, butene 1, butene 2, MTBE, benzene, and TX. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Yanbu, Saudi Arabia. Yanbu National Petrochemical Company is a subsidiary of Saudi Basic Industries Corporation.

name: Saudi Paper Manufacturing Co.
summary: Saudi Paper Manufacturing Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells paper pulp and tissue paper products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Gulf Cooperation Council countries, and internationally. It operates in Manufacturing, and Trading and Others segments. The company offers facial tissues, kitchen towels, maxi rolls, toilet paper, interfold towels, table napkins, interfolds, under pads, pocket tissues, napkins, and industrial tissue products under the Mouchoir, Excellence, City, SPC Pro, and Jumbo Roll brands. It also purchases, manufactures, and distributes pulps and papers; paper and waste recycling services, including collection and transportation of wastepaper, destroying and shredding archives of paper and confidential documents, sort and classify, packaging, and environment protection. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Dammam, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Sahara International Petrochemical Company
summary: Sahara International Petrochemical Company owns, establishes, operates, and manages industrial projects related to chemical and petrochemical industries in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Basic Chemicals, Intermediate Chemicals, Polymers, Trading, and Corporate and Others segments. It offers basic products, including methanol, butane, tetrahydrofuran, maleic anhydride, carbon monoxide, and gamma butyrolactone; and intermediate products, such as acetic acid, acetic anhydride, vinyl acetate monomer, dichloroethane, and caustic soda, as well as ethyl and butyl acetates. The company also provides polymer products consisting of low-density polyethylene (LDPE), ethylene vinyl acetate, polyvinyl acetate, polyvinyl alcohol, cross linkable and semi-conductive LDPE compounds, polypropylene, and polybutylene terephthalate. In addition, it markets and distributes other petrochemical products; offers electrical connecting wire products; and manufactures and sells molds and dies, and related services, as well as produces ethylene-vinyl acetate films. The company was formerly known as Saudi International Petrochemical Company and changed its name to Sahara International Petrochemical Company in May 2019. Sahara International Petrochemical Company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunication Co.
summary: Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunication Co., established in 1955 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, specializes in delivering comprehensive infrastructure solutions for the power and telecommunications sectors, both domestically and across international markets. Its extensive range of products for power applications includes diverse outdoor lighting solutions such as functional, decorative, flag, mid-hinged, and traffic poles, along with high masts and advanced HID and LED lighting for streets, floods, and obstruction marking. The company also fabricates crucial components for electrical utilities, including transmission and distribution towers and various utility poles. In the telecommunications domain, Al-Babtain provides broadcasting and guyed masts, a variety of self-supporting towers (triangular and square designs), standard and camouflage monopoles, rapid deployment vehicles, and flexible rooftop mounting options. Furthermore, for renewable energy projects, it supplies steel support structures for concentrated solar power (CSP), fixed photovoltaic (PV) structures, solar tracker components, and solar carports. Complementing its manufacturing capabilities, the company offers specialized services, encompassing the installation, maintenance, and repair of wind energy networks, as well as the production of galvanized poles and towers.

name: Advanced Petrochemical Company
summary: Advanced Petrochemical Company, through its subsidiaries, manufactures and globally distributes a core portfolio of petrochemicals including propylene, polypropylene, and isopropyl alcohol. The company also produces polysilicon and related downstream products like photovoltaic cells. Its offerings further encompass various polypropylene types such as homopolymers, high crystalline resins, and both random and block copolymers. Additionally, the firm is involved in establishing, operating, and investing in diverse industrial projects, spanning petrochemicals, chemicals, foundational and conversion industries, and renewable energy. Its critical materials are utilized across numerous sectors, contributing to products like personal care items, fresh food packaging, lightweight plastics, construction materials, automotive components, durable textiles, and medical devices. Advanced Petrochemical Company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Abdullatif Industrial Investment Company
summary: Al Abdullatif Industrial Investment Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells carpets worldwide. The company offers tufted and woven carpets, BCF yarns, carpet backings, masterbatches and colors, paper tubes, blankets, and rugs. It sells its products directly to manufacturers, exporters, importers, and retailers. The company was formerly known as Saudi Carpet Factory and changed its name to Al Abdullatif Industrial Investment Company in 2007. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Al Abdullatif Industrial Investment Company is a subsidiary of Al-Abdullatif Group Holding Company.

name: Saudi Kayan Petrochemical Company
summary: Saudi Kayan Petrochemical Company manufactures chemicals, polymers, and specialty products. The company offers ethylene for use as a feed stock for polyethylene and ethylene glycol; propylene for use as a feed stock for polypropylene and cumene; benzene for use as a feed stock for cumene plant; polypropylene for automotive, electric appliances, hot water pipe systems fibers, and film wraps; and high and low density polyethylene for automotive gasoline tanks, pipes, bottles, and containers. It also provides ethylene oxide for use as a feed stock to ethylene glycols, polycarbonates, and ethanolamines; monoethylene glycol for use in polyester fibers, soft drinks packaging, antifreeze and coolants, heat transfer fluids, and chemical intermediates; diethylene glycol used in unsaturated polyester resin, polyurethane, plasticizer, grinding aid, gas dehydration, printing ink, and paint pigment manufacturing; and triethylene glycol for the dehydration of industrial gases and solvents, and plasticizers. In addition, the company offers cumene used as a feed stock to phenol plant; phenol for use as a feed stock to Bisphenol-A plant; acetone used in solvents, and BPA and methyl methacrylate manufacturing; bisphenol A for use in polycarbonates and epoxy resins; and polycarbonate for use in optical media, construction and housing, automotive, aircraft, electronic components, lenses, toys, hobby items, and medical appliances. Further, it provides diethanolamine, diethanolamine, and monoethanolamine used in gas sweetening, detergent and specialty cleaning formulations, concrete mixtures, foam catalysts, pharmaceuticals, personal care products, and herbicides; ethoxylates for the detergent, paint, and leather industries; N-butanol for use in solvents, plasticizers, and coatings; iso-butanol used in direct solvents, chemical intermediates, and additives; and natural detergent alcohol for use in detergents. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Jubail, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Vitrified Clay Pipe co.
summary: Saudi Vitrified Clay Pipe co. manufactures and sells vitrified clay pipes and fittings in Saudi Arabia and internationally. It offers pipes, perforated pipes, flexible joints, junctions, bends, special fittings, and accessories. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Middle East Specialized Cables Co.
summary: Middle East Specialized Cables Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells fiber optic cables, steel insulated wires and cables, copper insulated wires and cables, and aluminum insulated wires and cables in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. The company offers instrumentation and process cables for use in oil, gas and petrochemical, automation and process control, and marine and offshore industries; building wires that are used in new constructions; power and control cables that are used in construction and industrial applications; and data and communication cables, such as co-axial, LAN, computer, telephone, and system cables. It also manufactures PVC compounds for wire and cable insulation and sheathing applications; and flexible cables used in various applications, including machine tool manufacture, power stations, heating and air conditioning installations, etc. In addition, the company produces and sells fire cables used as a fixed wiring within buildings for fire alarms systems; irrigation cables used in commercial sprinkler and irrigation systems, golf courses, public parks, plantations, and commercial produce farms; and bare copper used in earthling electrical systems and overhead electrical transmission and distribution system. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Rabigh Refining and Petrochemical Company
summary: Rabigh Refining and Petrochemical Company engages in the development, construction, and operation of an integrated refining and petrochemical complex in the Middle East, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. The company operates through Refined Products and Petrochemicals segments. It offers polymers, such as linear low density polyethylene, high density polyethylene, homopolymer polypropylene, and impact copolymer polypropylene; and monomers, including propylene oxide and mono ethylene glycol. The company also provides refined products comprising liquefied petroleum gas, naphtha, gasoline, gas oil, fuel oil, and kerosene. Its products are used in various end products, such as plastics, detergents, lubricants, resins, coolants, anti-freeze, paint, carpets, rope, clothing, shampoo, auto interiors, epoxy glue, insulation, film, fibers, household appliances, packaging, candles, pipes, and other applications. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Rabigh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabian Drilling Company
summary: Arabian Drilling Company (ADC) is a leading Saudi Arabian drilling contractor focused on the oil and natural gas industry, providing both land-based and marine operations. The firm offers a full spectrum of drilling solutions for the exploration and production of hydrocarbons, encompassing projects in shallow and deep offshore waters, as well as on land. ADC's expertise extends beyond primary drilling to include specialized well intervention and testing, rig deployment and relocation, and the provision of skilled manpower. The company maintains a significant operational fleet: 38 onshore rigs, ranging from medium to ultra-heavy capacity, and 7 ultra-heavy-duty jack-up rigs for its offshore ventures. Established in 1964, Arabian Drilling Company has its headquarters in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, and functions as a subsidiary of Industrialization & Energy Services Company.

name: Ades Holding Co.
summary: ADES Holding Company, through its various subsidiaries, specializes in providing a comprehensive suite of oil and gas drilling and production services throughout the Middle East and Asia. The company's core operations are divided into offshore and onshore segments. For its offshore clients, ADES offers drilling, well maintenance, and mobile offshore production unit (MOPU) production capabilities, supplemented by shipboard support services such as accommodation and catering. On the onshore front, the company delivers drilling, general maintenance, and extensive repair services. Founded in 2016, ADES Holding Company maintains its headquarters in Al Khobar, United Arab Emirates.

name: Hail Cement Company
summary: Hail Cement Company manufactures and sells cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It offers ordinary Portland, sulphate resistant, and masonry cement. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Hail, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Najran Cement Company
summary: Najran Cement Company manufactures and sells cement products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers ordinary Portland and cement resistant to salt. It also sells its products online. Najran Cement Company was founded in 2005 and is based in Najran, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: City Cement Company
summary: Operating within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, City Cement Company is a prominent manufacturer and distributor of various cement products. Its offerings include Ordinary Portland Cement, suitable for diverse uses such as plastering, masonry, finishing, block and tile production, reinforced concrete work, and cement pipe fabrication. The company also provides Sulfate Resistant Cement, specifically designed for challenging environments like dams, underground constructions, marine and port facilities, and sewage and water treatment plants. Additionally, City Cement extends its services to environmental solutions, particularly in waste treatment and recycling. Established in 2005, the firm maintains its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Northern Region Cement Company
summary: Northern Region Cement Company specializes in the production and distribution of various Portland cement types, serving both Saudi Arabia and The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio, including white Portland cement for precast, structural, and architectural concrete, along with white Portland limestone cement specifically designed for decorative concrete products and tiles. Its range also features ordinary Portland cement, an essential material for pavements, floors, buildings, bridges, railway structures, warehouses, tanks, water pipes, and general construction units. For demanding conditions, they supply sulfate-resistant grey Portland cement, ideal for concrete exposed to high sulfur environments, as well as specialized oil well cement. Beyond these, their products support diverse applications such as fountains, swimming pools, and general concrete structural reinforcement. Established in 2006, Northern Region Cement Company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Umm Al-Qura Cement Company
summary: Umm Al-Qura Cement Company produces and sells cement products. It offers ordinary portland cement, buzlana cement, resistant cement, clinker, and cement finishing products. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Zahrat Al Waha For Trading Company
summary: Zahrat Al Waha For Trading Company produces and sells plastic bottles preforms and plastic caps. It operates in Asia, Africa, Europe, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and Gulf countries. The company also exports its products. Zahrat Al Waha for Trading Company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Kathiri Holding Company
summary: Al Kathiri Holding Company manufactures, distributes, and transports cement and ready-made concrete to construction companies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also distributes construction materials, such as gravel and various types of sand. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabian Cement Company
summary: Arabian Cement Company engages in the production, trading, and selling of cement primarily in Saudi Arabia and Jordan. It also provides building materials and other related products. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Yamama Saudi Cement Company
summary: Yamama Saudi Cement Company manufactures and sells cement in Saudi Arabia. It offers ordinary Portland, clinker and finishing, sulfate-resistant Portland, white and colored, oil-well, fast cementing Bozolani, and bacteric resistant cement. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Cement Company
summary: Saudi Cement Company produces and distributes various cement types and related construction materials, serving markets both within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and abroad. Their offerings include ordinary Portland cement, sulfate-resistant cement, and cement clinkers. These crucial products are supplied for numerous construction projects, ranging from large-scale infrastructure like highways, bridges, airports, seaports, railways, and metro systems, to diverse residential and commercial developments. The company was founded in 1955 and is centrally located in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

name: Qassim Cement Company
summary: Qassim Cement Company manufactures and sells cement and its derivatives and supplements in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers ordinary Portland, Portland pozzolana, sulphate resistant, finishing, and limestone cement. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Buraydah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Southern Province Cement Company
summary: Southern Province Cement Company engages in the production and sale of cement, clinker, and its derivatives in Saudi Arabia. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Abha, Saudi Arabia.

name: Yanbu Cement Company
summary: Yanbu Cement Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing, producing, and trading in cement and related products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers ordinary Portland, Pozzolana Portland, hydraulic, and sulphate resistance cement products. It also manufactures cement bags. Yanbu Cement Company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Eastern Province Cement Co.
summary: Eastern Province Cement Company produces and sells clinker and cement in the Kingdom of Saudi and internationally. It offers ordinary Portland, sulphate resisting, and finishing cement, as well as pre-cast concrete products. The company also engages in the wholesale and retail of cement, gypsum, etc. Eastern Province Cement Company is headquartered in Dammam, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Tabuk Cement Company
summary: Tabuk Cement Company manufactures and sells cement and related products for construction industries and infrastructure projects in Saudi Arabia. It offers ordinary Portland cement, sulphate resisting Portland cement, and Portland pozzolan cement. The company also engages in the establishment of factories and plants for manufacturing cement related products and construction materials; and export of cement and related products. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Duba, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Jouf Cement Company
summary: Al Jouf Cement Company produces and sells cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It provides ordinary Portland, sulphate resistant cement, and pozzolana Portland cement. The company's cement is used to build bases and foundations, bridges and towers, concert roads, sewage plants, concrete pipes, etc. The company is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Riyadh Cement Company
summary: Riyadh Cement Company, headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is a producer and supplier of various cement products across several Middle Eastern nations. The company's market reach extends to Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, Qatar, and Oman. Its diverse portfolio includes both white and grey cement, alongside specialized varieties such as white Portland, Portland limestone, sulphate resisting Portland, and ordinary Portland cement. Founded in 1997, the organization was initially known as Saudi White Cement Company before rebranding to Riyadh Cement Company in February 2021.

name: Abdullah Al-Othaim Markets Company
summary: Abdullah Al-Othaim Markets Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale and retail trade of food supplies and other products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Egypt. The company imports, exports, wholesales, and retails food products, wheat, rice, meat, fish, dairy products, ghee, olive, halawa, pasta, and soft drinks, as well as fruits, vegetables, and agricultural products; livestock and household items; and ready-made clothes, sport clothes, jewelry, sewing tools, bags, leather products, decorations, dropped ceilings, and vehicles spare parts. It also establishes, operates, manages, and maintains supermarkets, commercial complexes, bakeries, and cafes; and provides catering, as well as labor services regarding house workers and employment in the public and private sectors. In addition, the company maintains training and educational, entertainment, and sports centers; offers computer services for application systems and databases; establishes agriculture projects; and undertakes general contracting, electrical and electronic, and reinforcing and carpentry works, as well as construction, maintenance, demolition, and restoration works primarily for highways, roads, streets, and bridges. Further, it is involved in the vegetables and fodder cultivation, livestock, poultry breeding, and general trading businesses; acquisition of land to construct buildings for lease or sale; and contracting of buildings. The company was formerly known as Abdullah Saleh Al-Othaim Markets Company and changed its name to Abdullah Al-Othaim Markets Company in September 2007. Abdullah Al-Othaim Markets Company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Mouwasat Medical Services Company
summary: Mouwasat Medical Services Company acquires, manages, operates, and maintains hospitals, medical centers, drug stores, and pharmacies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates a network of hospitals in Dammam, Jubail, Madinah, Khobar, Qatif, and Riyadh that provides a range of medical services. The company also operates skin care centers that offer clinical and cosmetic dermatology, aesthetic and reconstructive plastic surgery, weight reduction, and esthetician services; a fertility center; and a clinic for bariatric surgery. In addition, it is involved in the wholesale of medical equipment and drugs. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Dammam, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: United Electronics Company
summary: United Electronics Company (UEC), founded in 2002 and based in Al Khobar, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, is a multifaceted enterprise engaged in both wholesale and retail activities across Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through two primary divisions: its Retail/Wholesale Sales segment and its Consumer Finance business. Within its extensive retail and wholesale portfolio, UEC distributes a broad spectrum of items including electrical appliances, electronic devices, computers with their parts and accessories, furniture, medical supplies, and office equipment. The company also provides crucial support services such as installation, maintenance, repair, and warranty programs. Beyond its core offerings, UEC's operations extend to establishing and managing restaurants, providing third-party marketing solutions, and trading in drones. It also handles the sale of video and audio media materials, the import and export of computer software and hardware, and electronic games. Furthermore, the company is involved in maintaining electric devices and developing and managing personal properties. Specifically, UEC's retail arm features non-customized software, household appliances, toys, games, satellites, and mobile phones. Its wholesale operations encompass spare parts for a diverse range of electrical and digital equipment, including photocopiers, fax machines, telephones, cell phones, video and electric games, digital pocket assistants, printers, and various computer-related devices. A notable component of UEC's business is its consumer finance services, offered under the 'Tasheel' brand. As of April 25, 2022, United Electronics Company maintained a significant retail presence, with 48 eXtra stores operating in Saudi Arabia and an additional 53 stores located throughout the GCC countries.

name: Dallah Healthcare Company
summary: Dallah Healthcare Company provides and operates healthcare programs and utilities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company engages in operating, managing, equipping, and developing hospitals and healthcare facilities, medical policlinics, compounds, and lands; and the provision of manpower and support services to hospitals and medical centers. It also manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical, herbal, and cosmetic products to retail pharmacies, health and beauty stores, hospitals, and governmental agencies. In addition, the company engages in the management and operation of hospitals owned by third-parties; and provision of other support services. The company was formerly known as Dallah Healthcare Holding Company and changed its name to Dallah Healthcare Company in November 2016. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Dallah Healthcare Company is the subsidiary of Dallah Albaraka Group LLC.

name: National Medical Care Company
summary: National Medical Care Company is dedicated to the comprehensive establishment, ownership, operation, and maintenance of healthcare facilities across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its substantial portfolio includes the 325-bed Riyadh Care Hospital, the 459-bed National Hospital, the Family Health Care Center, and the Care Company for Pharmaceutical and Medical Distribution. In addition to these institutional services, the company also provides home healthcare. Founded in 2003, it is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Marketing Company
summary: Headquartered in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, Saudi Marketing Company was established in 1978. The company operates across Saudi Arabia, specializing in retail, trading, and importing, with a primary focus on foodstuffs and consumer goods. Its business is structured into three segments: Retail, Household, and Entertainment Service. The company manages its retail outlets under the Farm Superstores brand, overseeing a substantial network that includes 90 main branches and 17 mini-markets serving residential complexes. Furthermore, Saudi Marketing Company diversifies its services by operating children's play areas.

name: Al Hammadi Company For Development and Investment
summary: Al Hammadi Company For Development and Investment establishes, maintains, manages, and operates hospitals and medical centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Medical Services and Pharmaceuticals Products segments. It is also involved in the wholesale and retail trading of medical equipment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic products, and food and beverages; and the acquisition and rental of land for constructing buildings. In addition, the company invests in various industrial projects; and establishes, operates, and maintains commercial centers. It operates three hospitals under the Al Hammadi Hospital name in Olaya, Suwaidi, and Al Nuzha districts of Riyadh. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Company for Hardware
summary: The Saudi Company for Hardware (4008.SR) primarily functions as a retailer and wholesaler, supplying a comprehensive range of household and office goods, including appliances and general supplies. It also provides construction and electrical tools, as well as various hardware components. Operating throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the company is structured around two key operational divisions: Sales and Services, and Logistic Services. Beyond its core retail and wholesale activities, the firm extends its offerings to include comprehensive logistics solutions such as freight forwarding, transportation, and contract logistics services. Demonstrating a significant presence, as of January 9, 2022, SCH managed 35 retail locations spread across 19 different cities, complemented by a robust online sales channel. Established in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, in 1985, the company maintains its headquarters there.

name: Middle East Healthcare Company
summary: Middle East Healthcare Company is a prominent medical service provider that manages and operates an extensive network of Saudi German Hospitals throughout the Middle East and North Africa region. These facilities offer comprehensive multi-specialty tertiary care. The company's diverse hospital portfolio includes Saudi German Hospital-Jeddah with 218 beds, Saudi German Hospital-Aseer featuring 400 beds, Saudi German Hospital-Riyadh and Saudi German Hospital-Madinah each equipped with 300 beds, and Saudi German Hospital-Hail providing 150 beds. Expanding its reach further, the network also encompasses Saudi German Hospital-Dammam, offering 150 to 300 beds; Saudi German Hospital-Sanaa and Saudi German Hospital-Dubai, both with 300 beds; Saudi German Hospital-Sharjah, a 50-bed facility; Saudi German Hospital-Ajman, which has between 100 and 200 beds; and Saudi German Hospital-Cairo, accommodating 332 patients. Established in 1988, the company's primary corporate base is situated in Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: L'azurde Company for Jewelry
summary: L'azurde Company for Jewelry, together with its subsidiaries, produces, manufactures, forms, and forges golden wares, jewelry, precious stones, and golden alloys. It operates in Wholesale and Retail segments. The company also distributes glasses, watches, accessories, pens, perfumes, and leather products; and manages franchises and trademarks; as well as exports gold wares, alloys, and silver. It primarily operates in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Egypt, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, the Sultanate of Oman, and Qatar. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. L'azurde Company for Jewelry is a subsidiary of L'Azurde Holding Company.

name: Thob Al Aseel Co.
summary: Thob Al Aseel Co. develops, imports, exports, wholesales, and retails fabrics and readymade clothes. It operates through Thobs and Fabrics segments. The company offers thobes, pants, underwear, pajamas, and sleeping robes, as well as miscellaneous products, such as T-shirts, ehram products, and cotton socks. It also sells women's, men's, and children's fabrics and clothing products, as well as sewing supplements. The company operates through a chain of retail outlets under the Al-Jedaie brand. Thob Al Aseel Co. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Medical Services Group Company
summary: Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Medical Services Group Company develops, owns, and operates hospitals and medical centers. The company operates spinal surgery, vascular, general medicine, urology, dental, diabetes and endocrine, ENT, family medicine, gastroenterology, general surgery, sport medicine, rheumatology, internal medicine, nutrition, nephrology, neurology, neurosurgery, orthopedic, OB/GYN, pulmonary, psychiatry, pediatric, and pain treatment clinics. It also operates physiotherapy, plastic surgery, cardiology, dermatology, in vitro fertilization, obesity treatment, ophthalmology, and laser hair removal centers; endoscopy, speech therapy, intensive care, hematology, kidney dialysis, sleep disorder treatment, laser and Lasik eye surgery, nuclear medicine, low vision, and ER units; a tissue laboratory and radiology center; and pharmacies. Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Medical Services Group Company was founded in 1995 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Scientific and Medical Equipment House
summary: Scientific & Medical Equipment House engages in the maintenance and repair for medical devices, equipment and supplies. Its services include manpower, subcontractors for maintenance of specialized systems, spare parts and consumables supply, maintenance & catering. The company was founded by Saud bin Muhammad bin Nasser Al-Arifi on November 19, 1979 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Jamjoom Pharmaceuticals Factory Company
summary: Established in 1994, Jamjoom Pharmaceuticals Factory Company, headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, is a key player in the production and commercialization of medicinal products. The firm serves markets both within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and across various international regions. Its extensive product portfolio addresses a wide array of therapeutic needs, covering ophthalmology, dermatology, gastrointestinal issues, cardiovascular health, central nervous system disorders, as well as general medicine, over-the-counter remedies, and nutraceuticals/consumer health products.

name: Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company
summary: Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company (MEPIC), established in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in 1998, is a global pharmaceutical entity. The company's core activities encompass the entire lifecycle of generic medicines and various pharmaceutical products, from research and development to manufacturing and sales, catering to both local and international markets. Its business operations are strategically divided into private sector, public sector, and export divisions. MEPIC offers an extensive array of products designed to address a wide range of medical conditions. This includes dermatological treatments, remedies for respiratory ailments, central nervous system disorders, digestive issues, and musculoskeletal complaints, alongside medications for the urinary and reproductive systems. Furthermore, the company provides disinfectants and a diverse portfolio of therapeutic agents covering areas such as sexual health, diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, anti-infectives, anti-parasitics, pain relief, antiseptics, and general men's and women's health. These pharmaceutical and health products are supplied in numerous formats, including creams, ointments, syrups, capsules, tablets, gels, lotions, sprays, topical solutions, and personal hygiene items like hand sanitizers, mouthwashes, and soaps. In addition to its proprietary product lines, MEPIC leverages its manufacturing capabilities to offer contract manufacturing services. The company also specializes in cosmetic products, general health aids, and nutritional supplements. Originally known as Middle East Chemical Products Factory Company, the organization officially rebranded to Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company in January 2006.

name: Dr. Soliman Abdul Kader Fakeeh Hospital Co.
summary: Dr. Soliman Abdel Kader Fakeeh Hospital Company, together with its subsidiaries, establishes, operates, and manages hospitals, clinics, medical, educational, and training centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Medical Services; Education; and Trading, Retail & Others segments. It provides various services, such as assisted reproductive therapy, audiology, bariatric surgery, pediatric, breast feeding, cardiac surgery, cardiology, chest and respiratory diseases, chiropractic medicine, dental and maxillofacial, dermatology, otorhinolaryngology, endocrinology, ophthalmology, family medicine, gastroenterology, general surgery, geriatric medicine, hematology, hyperbaric oxygen service, infectious diseases, internal medicine, interventional radiology, psychiatry, lasik surgery, nephrology, neuro surgery, neurology, nutrition, obstetrics and gynecology, oncology, orthopedics, pediatric orthopedic surgery, pediatric surgery, physical medicine and rehabilitation, plastic surgery, rheumatology, sleep disorders clinic, speech therapy, thoracic surgery, urology, and vascular surgery, as well as pain treatment and palliative care services. The company also operates AIRS, anesthesia, burn, diagnostics service, emergency medicine, endoscopy, intensive care, NICU, renal dialysis, rhinoplasty, and institute of robotic surgery facilities; establishes and manages pharmacies; and provides analysis and radiology laboratory, healthcare, medical education, and home health care services. In addition, it engages in the trading of pharmaceutical products, spectacles, and cosmetics; construction and contracting; wholesale and retail of medical equipment; and maintenance of IT equipment and software related services. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Almoosa Health Company
summary: Almoosa Health Company functions as a private healthcare provider situated in Saudi Arabia. The firm engages in storing medical goods and distributing pharmaceuticals, beauty products, and single-use medical supplies. Additionally, it oversees the operation of hospitals and pharmacies, offering a comprehensive suite of services that includes critical care, active rehabilitation, extended care, in-home healthcare assistance, and health-related educational programs. Founded in 1996, the company is headquartered in Al Mubarraz, Saudi Arabia, and operates as a subsidiary of Abdulaziz bin Abdullah Almoosa Investment Company.

name: Specialized Medical Company
summary: Based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and established in 1994, Specialized Medical Company operates an extensive network of hospitals, clinics, and medical centers throughout the Kingdom. Its diverse activities are categorized into two primary segments: Medical Services, and Pharmacies & Other Offerings. The company delivers a full spectrum of medical care, encompassing both diagnostic and therapeutic treatments across numerous specialties. These include urgent care, cardiology, internal and family medicine, and pediatrics. Essential ancillary services are also provided, such as laboratory diagnostics (including histopathology), advanced imaging (radiology and nuclear medicine), anesthesiology, pharmaceutical supply, and physiotherapy rehabilitation. Furthermore, Specialized Medical Company boasts comprehensive surgical capabilities, with specialized units for operating rooms, post-operative recovery, maternity (delivery), ophthalmology, general surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, urology, orthopedics, and ear, nose, and throat (ENT) procedures. Critical care is a key offering, featuring specialized intensive care units for neonates (NICU), cardiac patients (CCU), and general critical conditions (ICU). Beyond conventional medicine, the company extends its portfolio to include dermatology, anti-aging, aesthetic services, home healthcare, virtual consultations, and dentistry. In addition to its healthcare provisions, the company's "Pharmacies & Other" segment encompasses a range of services such as the provision of prepared and unprepared food, maintenance for hospital and other facilities, and the management and operation of restaurants, alongside other non-medical, healthy food, and food-related enterprises.

name: Saudi Real Estate Company
summary: Saudi Real Estate Company, established in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in 1976, functions as a diversified real estate developer. Its core business involves the construction, maintenance, and operation of both residential and commercial buildings for sale and lease. The company also delivers comprehensive project, property, and facility management solutions. Beyond property development, SRECO's activities span the production of construction materials and equipment. It undertakes extensive infrastructure projects, including the construction, expansion, cleaning, and upkeep of water, sewerage, and drainage networks. The company is also proficient in building critical transportation infrastructure such as roads, bridges, tunnels, and performing earthworks. Its capabilities extend to the installation and maintenance of utility grids, specifically electrical power and gas distribution networks, as well as telecommunication networks and towers. Furthermore, SRECO contributes to public amenities through the construction and maintenance of parks, irrigation systems, and dams, along with the upkeep and sale of precast concrete products. The company's service portfolio also includes the operation and maintenance of healthcare facilities, encompassing hospitals, medical centers, and various clinics. Additionally, it actively engages in real estate investment and offers specialized services like electrical works and landscape maintenance.

name: Canadian General Medical Center Complex Company
summary: Canadian General Medical Center Complex Company engages in the management of hospitals and health centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers ambulance transport, medical examinations and training, home healthcare and ambulance services, medical coverage for events, medical support at industrial sites, medical support at construction sites, and medical support at onshore and offshore sites, as well as operates medical centers. It also trades in hospital tools and equipment and ambulances. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Dammam, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: The National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia
summary: The National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia (NSCSA), along with its subsidiaries, is engaged in the acquisition, sale, and operation of a diverse fleet of vessels primarily for global cargo transportation, headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its operations are structured across several key divisions: oil transport, chemical transport, logistics, and dry bulk shipping. NSCSA is responsible for moving a range of commodities, including crude oil, petrochemical products, and liquefied petroleum gas. The company's service offerings extend to specialized technical vessel management, comprehensive logistics support, and the provision of grain packaging and storage solutions. Additionally, it acts as an agent for various maritime shipping firms, handles cargo clearance, and organizes both transport and onboard storage. NSCSA also participates in other marine transport activities and holds investments in both real estate and other corporate entities. As of December 31, 2021, the company commanded a fleet of 90 vessels, which included 47 crude oil carriers, 28 chemical tankers, 6 RoCon vessels, and 9 dry bulk carriers. Established in 1978, NSCSA maintains its corporate headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Ground Services Company
summary: Saudi Ground Services Company provides ground-handling services for passengers and aircraft in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers a range of passenger services, including arrival and transfer, passenger manifesting and seat allocation, station management, gate, and VIP services, as well as check-in services, such as boarding pass and baggage tagging, and load planning and pre-flight editing services. The company also provides baggage handling services comprising baggage sorting and transportation, and lost and found services; ramp services; cargo loading/offloading services; and fleet cleaning services, such as cabin grooming, deep cleaning, and turnaround cleaning, as well as water and toilet services. In addition, it offers operation services and traffic control services. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Saudi Ground Services Company is a subsidiary of Saudi Arabian Airlines Corporation.

name: Saudi Public Transport Company
summary: Saudi Public Transport Company (SAPTCO) is a prominent provider of transportation solutions, serving customers both domestically within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company's diverse operations are structured across passenger services, specialized logistics, and public transportation infrastructure projects. For individuals, SAPTCO offers a range of options including school, university, and staff bus transport, private vehicle hire, extensive intercity, international, and urban transit networks, and luxury limousine services catering to both corporate and private clients. Furthermore, it operates Rekab, an innovative on-demand mobility platform. Beyond passenger conveyance, the company manages cargo and parcel delivery, provides VIP logistical support, and facilitates vehicle rentals, contract services, leasing, and charters. SAPTCO also plays a key role in the operation and upkeep of various fleets, encompassing trains, metros, motor vehicles, trucks, and buses, in addition to organizing travel tours. Founded in 1979, the company maintains its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Automotive Services Company
summary: Saudi Automotive Services Company (SASCO), established in 1981 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operates as a multifaceted service provider with a diverse portfolio. Its primary business involves managing a comprehensive network of automotive service stations throughout Saudi Arabia, offering vehicle maintenance, repair, and fuel and water transportation services. These stations are equipped with various amenities for travelers, including restrooms, motels, restaurants, and provisions for meals, drinks, and refreshments, alongside car washing and lubrication facilities. Beyond its core service station operations, SASCO is deeply involved in various other automotive sectors. This includes running an automobile association responsible for issuing international driving licenses and customs transit books. The company also imports and sells vehicles, spare parts, tools, and equipment. Furthermore, SASCO actively participates in and manages local and international car and motorcycle clubs, circuits for motorsports, and organizes racing events. SASCO's ventures extend significantly into real estate, where it engages in the acquisition, development, purchase, sale, and leasing of land and properties. The company also undertakes contracts for the construction, management, maintenance, and operation of both residential and commercial buildings, as well as road construction and infrastructure projects, including bridges. Additionally, the company diversifies its revenue through the import and supply of foodstuffs, beverages, and raw materials. Saudi Automotive Services Company also provides financial services.

name: Baazeem Trading Co.
summary: Baazeem Trading Co. operates as a FMCG distribution company. The company offers household cleaning solutions, such as sponge, scrubbers, steel wool, brooms, wipers, trash bags, food storage bags, table covers, and others; liquid detergents; cleaners; tuna; starch sprays; plastic oven bags; toilet cleaning products; and bed linens. It sells its products through business to business, discount store, and wholesale and retail channels in the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Bahrain, and the Sultanate of Oman. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Anaam International Holding Group Company
summary: Anaam International Holding Group Company engages in food, agriculture, and estate development businesses in Saudi Arabia. The company imports, distributes, and sells frozen food products, including chicken, mutton, fish, potatoes, vegetables, fruits, and other products. It also produces grain and fodder products, such as alfalfa, corn, wheat, fruits and vegetables, tomatoes, potatoes, onions, and other products, as well as owns agricultural land with an area of 100,000,000 square meters in the fertile agricultural Albesitae northern Saudi Arabia. In addition, the company manages and leases cold and dry storage facilities; builds, manages, and maintains commercial centers; and builds, manages, and operates industrial projects. Further, it undertakes contracts to build residential complexes, commercial centers, economic cities, and industrial properties; constructs, sells, and leases buildings; leases construction machinery and equipment; and undertakes finishing works in construction, as well as provides construction maintenance, and construction materials wholesale and retail services. Anaam International Holding Group Company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Tihama Advertising and Public Relations Co.
summary: Tihama Advertising and Public Relations Co. engages in the advertising in Saudi Arabia and internationally. It offers outdoor commercial advertising in Jeddah, Riyadh, Eastern Province, Western Region, and Madinah. Tihama Advertising and Public Relations Co. was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabian Contracting Services Company
summary: Operating through its subsidiaries within Saudi Arabia, Arabian Contracting Services Company offers a broad spectrum of services. The company's primary focus includes advertising and printing, encompassing the production of commercial correspondence, invoices, and various promotional materials such as advertisements, posters, and flyers. It also provides photo engraving services, engages in the wholesale distribution of gifts and luxury goods, and orchestrates the management of exhibitions and conferences. Furthermore, the company holds a significant position in the construction sector, undertaking projects that range from the erection of residential buildings and the casting of structural bases and foundations, to the development of extensive infrastructure like bridges, tunnels, railway networks, roads, and sidewalks. Its capabilities also extend to the installation of electrical and communication wiring. Arabian Contracting Services Company was established in 1983 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: MBC Group Co.
summary: MBC Group Co. functions as a prominent media conglomerate with operations spanning the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Iraq, the wider North African region, and other international markets. Its extensive portfolio encompasses numerous television channels tailored to diverse audiences. These include popular general entertainment options like MBC1, MBC MASR, MBC MASR 2, and MBC+ VARIETY; dedicated movie channels such as MBC2 for Hollywood films and MBC MAX; MBC3, specifically for children's programming; and drama-centric channels like MBC4, featuring Turkish, Korean, Spanish, and Arabic series, alongside MBC Drama and MBC+ DRAMA for on-demand Arabic productions. The group also offers MBC Cinq, which highlights North African cultural and historical content; MBC IRAQ, delivering premium content to Iraqi viewers; the action and sports-focused MBC Action; MBC Bollywood, an Indian entertainment channel; and MBC Persia, providing Farsi-dubbed dramas, comedies, talent shows, and movies. Music enthusiasts can enjoy WANASAH TV. Beyond its television broadcasting, MBC Group manages a collection of radio stations, namely MBC FM, Panorama FM, Loud FM, and MBC MOOD. It is also the force behind Shahid, a leading Arabic streaming platform, and operates MBC STUDIOS, its internal production division. The company actively nurtures media talent through MBC ACADEMY, an educational and training initiative, and MBC TALENT, a specialized creative community agency for the entertainment sector. Its digital footprint includes the WIZZO mobile gaming application, GOBX for accessing free-to-air channels, and interactive engagement platforms such as DREAM and FlashWin. Furthermore, MBC Group provides a broad spectrum of services, including artist, producer, and talent management, complemented by music publishing, tour organization, and merchandise. It delivers advertising and content development solutions, manages events and exhibitions, and specializes in media content production. The company also engages in e-commerce, offering technical management for digital platforms and participating in the brokerage, creation, and distribution of artwork. Founded in 1991, MBC Group Co. is headquartered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and operates as a subsidiary of Al Istedamah Holding Company.

name: Sinad Holding Company
summary: Sinad Holding Company, Tourism and Manufacturing Co., an investment holding company, engages in the industry, trade, tourism, agriculture, real estate development, and contracting activities. It invests in preserved food, real estate development, building and construction materials, electrical and electronic home appliances, petrochemical and derivatives, and financial and service sectors. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Abha, Saudi Arabia. Sinad Holding Company, Tourism and Manufacturing Co. is a subsidiary of Dallah Albaraka Holding Company.

name: Nayifat Finance Company
summary: Operating as a non-banking financial institution, Nayifat Finance Company specializes in providing Shariah-compliant financing to individuals and businesses across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its offerings encompass a range of financial products, including lease finance, funding for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), personal consumer loans, and credit card services. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Morabaha Marina Financing Company
summary: Morabaha Marina Financing Company, established in 2012 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, provides diverse financial services across the Kingdom. These offerings encompass financial leasing, along with funding solutions tailored for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and individual consumers. The company operates through distinct divisions including Retail, SMEs, and Digital Payments, with the latter also extending electronic wallet services.

name: United International Holding Company
summary: Operating across Saudi Arabia, United International Holding Company and its affiliates deliver a suite of digital financial solutions to consumers. These primarily involve personal loans, installment payment options, and credit card facilities. Beyond its consumer-facing activities, the company also offers a variety of support services to financial institutions and other businesses. These B2B offerings include managing processing operations, providing remote technical assistance, ensuring data backup, facilitating card payments, and supplying general technical expertise. Additionally, they handle call center operations, application processing, and comprehensive IT support for their corporate clients. Established in 2021, United International Holding Company is headquartered in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, and functions as a subsidiary of United Electronics Company.

name: Derayah Financial Company
summary: Derayah Financial Co. is a financial firm that offers brokerage services, advisory and custody solutions, acts as both principal and agent, and manages and arranges securities. It operates through the following segments: Brokerage and Trading, Asset Management, Murabaha, Investment, and Advisory. The Brokerage and Trading segment provides brokerage services and trading facilities for various financial instruments, along with financing options like margin, Murabaha, and free financing. The Asset Management segment earns fees from the discretionary management of portfolios, funds, real estate, and alternative investments. The Investment segment engages in managing proprietary investments, primarily focusing on funds it manages. The Murabaha segment engages in generating special commission income from clients' money accounts and its own investments. The Advisory segment engages in advising clients on integrated investment solutions, including investment strategy, manager selection, and program strategies for institutional and individual investors. The company was founded by Taha Al-Kuwaiz in 2009 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Taiba Investments Co.
summary: Taiba Investments Co. invests in, owns, buys, sells, leases, operates, maintains, and manages real estate properties in Saudi Arabia. The company also invests in, owns, operates, maintains, and manages hotels, hospitals, and recreational and tourist facilities; and operates, maintains, and manages cities, and public and private facilities. In addition, the company is involved in architectural, civil, mechanical, and electrical contracting; and agricultural, industrial, and mining activities. Further, it is involved in the provision of credit and mortgage services. The company was formerly known as Taiba Holding Co. and changed its name to Taiba Investments Co. in May 2019. Taiba Investments Co. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Medina, Saudi Arabia.

name: Makkah Construction & Development Company
summary: Makkah Construction & Development Company invests in, buys, develops, owns, manages, and rents real estate properties in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also undertakes engineering, construction, reconstruction, maintenance, demolition, and survey works. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Mecca, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Batic Investments and Logistics Company
summary: Batic Investments and Logistics Co. invests in logistic, private security, and related technologies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It provides ground and refrigerated transport. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Darb Saudi Investment Company
summary: Saudi Darb Investment Co. specializes in launching a variety of industrial ventures. Its scope of work includes acquiring and preparing land for the establishment of agricultural and livestock endeavors, developing recreational and tourism amenities, and managing cold storage facilities alongside maintenance and repair workshops. The firm operates through distinct divisions, which comprise its Head Quarter, Poultry Farms, a Leather Factory, the Cable Car Project, and Rental services. This company was inaugurated on November 30, 1992, and its main office is situated in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Industrial Export Company
summary: Saudi Industrial Export Company provides supply chain and trade solutions in the Middle East and African regions. The company engages in the wholesale of lubricating oils and refined petroleum products, cement, gypsum and the like, raw plastic materials, and rubber and synthetic fibres. It offers payment alternatives and financing solutions to fund and expand operations; commodity exchange solutions and warehouse management systems; and commercial insurance protection services. It also provides physical movement of goods services for import and export, including drayage to and from ports; negotiated trucking, air, and containership contracted rates; coverage of all lanes and capacity requirements; value-added services, packaging, kitting, and processing; collateral management agreements; and chartering services/bulk logistics. In addition, the company offers integrated information flow solutions, including internal market research data mine and IQ International capabilities; SaaS ecommerce platform for trading, product cataloging, vendor profiles, and routing guide compliance; configures, manages, and expands B2B storefronts; control tower visibility across entire supply chain; transactions across all currencies; and bid options on required services. Saudi Industrial Export Company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Al-Omran Industrial Trading Company
summary: Established in 2003 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Al-Omran Industrial Trading Company is a comprehensive provider engaged in the manufacturing, importing, distribution (wholesale and retail), and export of a broad spectrum of household and electronic products. Their extensive inventory includes major appliances like air conditioners (and their spare parts), refrigerators, freezers, and water coolers. The company also offers cutlery such as spoons and forks, various plastic goods including knives, chairs, containers, and refrigerator door profiles, as well as retail fixtures like shopping carts and display shelves. Additionally, their portfolio extends to metal, paper, and cardboard products, alongside specialized fittings and other industrial components.

name: Riyadh Cables Group Company
summary: Riyadh Cables Group Company, established in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in 1984, is a prominent manufacturer and supplier specializing in a wide array of wires and cables. The firm primarily serves the power transmission and telecommunications sectors within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, in addition to exporting its products to approximately 34 countries worldwide. Its extensive product offerings include standard wires; low, medium, high, and extra-high voltage cables; and specialized overhead line conductors, such as aerial bundle cables and high-temperature low-sag conductors. The company also provides instrumentation and control cables, renewable energy cables, and fiber optic and telephone cables. Furthermore, it produces essential raw materials like copper and aluminum rods, XLPE and PVC insulation compounds, and wooden and steel drums. Beyond manufacturing, Riyadh Cables Group Company delivers a comprehensive suite of services. These encompass cable installation, jointing, on-site testing and commissioning, system design for both cables and installations, and technical training. The company also offers ongoing monitoring, repair, and maintenance support for its solutions.

name: Al Taiseer Group Talco Industrial Co.
summary: Al Taiseer Group TALCO Industrial Company, established in 1976 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, specializes in the comprehensive design, production, and distribution of a wide array of aluminum products. The company's offerings include advanced aluminum extrusion, various decorative surface finishes, and crucial thermal barriers. These versatile products are extensively utilized across numerous applications, such as architectural elements like building facades, towers, doors, windows, and curtain walls, as well as components for kitchens, truck bodies, scaffolding, metal and general formwork, sun insulators, electrical cable carriers, stairs, and air conditioning networks.

name: Raoom trading Company
summary: Raoom Trading Co. engages in the manufacture and trading of all kinds of glass products, such as transparent, colored and reflective, in addition to all types of mirrors, lexan, crystal and decorative accessories, in various sizes and measurements to meet all architectural, and engineering requirements. The company was founded on August 4, 1992 and is headquartered in Buraydah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Obeikan Glass Company
summary: Al Obeikan Glass Company specializes in the wholesale and retail distribution of chemicals and diverse glass products, serving markets both domestically in Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through distinct Glass and Aluminum segments. Beyond its core offerings, Al Obeikan is involved in quarry management and the operation of sand and gravel mines, including associated crushing facilities. It also manufactures and supplies a range of glass types, such as float, laminated, and insulating glass, primarily utilized in construction. Additionally, the firm offers consultation services. Established in 2006, Al Obeikan Glass Company is headquartered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Gas Arabian Services Co.
summary: Gas Arabian Services Co. (GASCO) is a Saudi Arabian enterprise offering a comprehensive array of solutions across automation, instrumentation, field support, mechanical work, and piping throughout the Kingdom. Its operations are structured into three distinct divisions: Technical Services, Trading, and Manufacturing. The Technical Services segment specializes in providing skilled personnel and executing complex engineering projects. Through its Trading division, the company supplies a wide range of industrial components, including electrical, mechanical, hydromechanical, and petroleum-related equipment, alongside other specialized technical apparatus. The Manufacturing arm focuses on producing and distributing vital industrial goods such as piping spools, fabricated structural steel, pressure reduction units, and various other crucial components. GASCO's diverse client base spans critical sectors including oil and gas, petrochemicals, power generation, metallurgy, water and desalination, and mining. Established in 1992, the company maintains its primary operations in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

name: Consolidated Grunenfelder Saady Holding Company
summary: Consolidated Grunenfelder Saady Holding Company specializes in the production of diverse refrigeration and cold-storage systems. Its product portfolio includes temperature-regulated logistics vehicles, comprehensive industrial and commercial cooling solutions, and portable cold storage units. Furthermore, the company develops offerings such as telecommunications solutions, offshore and land-based containers, mobile medical clinics, and specialized defense and automotive systems. Their clientele encompasses a broad spectrum of industries, including agriculture, telecommunications, dairy, poultry and general farming, aquaculture, the food and beverage sector, and quick-service restaurant chains. The firm was established in 1976 and maintains its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Alwasail Industrial Company
summary: Alwasail Industrial Company, founded in 1979 and headquartered in Buraydah, Saudi Arabia, is a key manufacturer and supplier of polyethylene pipes and fittings. The company's operations span the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Oman, and the United Arab Emirates, supplemented by international exports. Its comprehensive product range includes pipes tailored for irrigation, water supply, gas distribution, industrial applications, wastewater drainage, and telecommunications ducts. Additionally, Alwasail provides various fittings such as barbed, compression, electrofusion, and economical options. Beyond manufacturing, the company also acts as a wholesaler for a diverse array of plastic materials, rubber, synthetic fibers, and plastic pipes, hoses, tubes, components, and accessories. These offerings are widely utilized across numerous sectors, including irrigation, water management, telecommunications, electrical infrastructure, industrial operations, oil and gas, wastewater management, and building sanitation. The company, originally known as Alwasail Agricultural Company, rebranded to Alwasail Industrial Company in 1990.

name: Arriyadh Development Co.
summary: Arriyadh Development Co. builds, manages, rents, and sells facilities, commercial and residential buildings, prefabricated buildings, government buildings, service buildings, public parks, and tourism and residential compounds in Saudi Arabia. It also engages in the management, rental, and sale of construction projects, commercial and industrial exhibitions, and renovations of residential and non-residential buildings. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Thimar Development Holding Company
summary: Operating within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thimar Development Holding Company focuses on the distribution and sale of agricultural and food products through marketing, wholesale, and retail channels. Its offerings encompass a variety of fresh, chilled, and frozen meat products, alongside livestock. The company also extends its activities to include managing and maintaining agricultural endeavors, as well as overseeing the operation of central wholesale marketplaces. Established in 1987, Thimar Development Holding's corporate headquarters are located in Riyadh. The firm adopted its current name in November 2021, having formerly operated as the National Agricultural Marketing Company.

name: Bin Dawood Holding Company
summary: Bin Dawood Holding Company engages in retail trading of foodstuff and household items. The company is also involved in the wholesale of bakery and related products to commercial supermarkets. It operates 74 hypermarkets and supermarkets under the BinDawood and Danube brands in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Almunajem Foods Company
summary: Operating within Saudi Arabia, Almunajem Foods Company specializes in procuring, promoting, and supplying a diverse array of frozen, refrigerated, and ambient food products. In addition to food distribution, the company extends its expertise to logistics, providing essential warehousing and transport solutions. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses various categories such as poultry (including chicken and derived products), a range of meats, and dairy items like cheeses, butter, cream, and evaporated milk. Further offerings include French fries, olives and olive oil, seafood, fruits (notably avocado pulp), and basmati rice. These products reach consumers and businesses via wholesale, retail, and dedicated food service channels. The company's broad client base spans the food service sector, serving caterers, airlines, hotels, various restaurant types (fast food, traditional, luxury), cafes, and juice establishments. It also supplies large format retailers like hypermarkets, supermarkets, and superstores, alongside smaller outlets such as mini-markets, baqalas, independent retailers, and directly serves individual purchasers. Established in 1950, Almunajem Foods Company operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, functioning as a subsidiary of the Abdullah Ali Almunajem Sons Company.

name: Al-Dawaa Medical Services Company
summary: Al-Dawaa Medical Services Company operates as a prominent pharmaceutical retail enterprise throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, conducting its business through distinct retail and wholesale divisions. The company provides a comprehensive selection of products, including pharmaceuticals, fragrances, beauty accessories, cosmetics, and other general healthcare items. Beyond its core sales operations, Al-Dawaa is actively involved in managing pharmacies, overseeing pharmaceutical warehouses, retailing medical equipment, offering land transportation for goods, managing self-storage facilities, and providing marketing services for external entities. It also serves as a pharmaceutical agent. The company connects with customers via an extensive network of 837 pharmacies, augmented by its online and wholesale distribution channels. Al-Dawaa Medical Services Company was established in 1991 and is based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia.

name: Nahdi Medical Company
summary: Nahdi Medical Company stands as a prominent pharmaceutical retail chain with operations spanning both the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a diverse range of pharmaceutical goods, health and wellness items, maternal and infant care essentials, beauty products, and various fast-moving consumer goods. Beyond retail, Nahdi provides a comprehensive suite of omni-health services, including polyclinics, rapid-care clinics, telemedicine platforms, laboratory facilities, and home healthcare programs. The company is also actively involved in the wholesale and retail distribution of cosmetics, medicines, specialized dietary products, healthy food options, and medical equipment. With approximately 1,151 pharmacies under its management, Nahdi Medical Company was established in 1986 and maintains its headquarters in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. It operates as a subsidiary under the umbrella of both Alnahdi Holding Company Limited and Saudi Economic and Development Company Limited.

name: Al Majed Oud Co.
summary: Operating across Saudi Arabia and the broader Gulf region, Al Majed Oud Co. specializes in the wholesale and retail of an extensive range of fragrances. Its offerings encompass traditional scents such as oud, musk, incense, and saffron, as well as a diverse selection of oriental and western perfumes.
