Beyond its core fragrance business, the company's retail segment includes cosmetics, bags, eyewear, antiques, gift items, and ornamental flowers. Al Majed Oud also undertakes the manufacturing of various products, including air fresheners, deodorizers, distinct men's and women's perfumes, oud oil, and agarwood and incense articles. Furthermore, it provides blending and packaging services for perfumes, essential oils, and botanicals. Consumers can access these products through the company's network of stores and its e-commerce platform. Established in 1956, Al Majed Oud Co. maintains its principal office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Tourism Enterprises Co.
summary: Tourism Enterprises Co. specializes in overseeing a variety of commercial and hospitality properties across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The firm's extensive management portfolio encompasses facilities such as vacation chalets, motels, hotels, recreational parks, dining establishments, urban developments, play areas, aquatic centers, rest stops, and central service hubs, in addition to other related offerings. A key asset under its direct ownership and operation is the Palm Beach Resort. The company was established in 1991 and maintains its primary base of operations in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

name: Fitaihi Holding Group
summary: Fitaihi Holding Group provides gold, jewelry, and luxury products primarily in Saudi Arabia. The company offers gifts, crystal and silverware products, antiques, chinaware, textiles, leather goods, chocolates, bed-linen, toilet sets, and accessories, as well as men's, women's, and children's wear products. It also produces agricultural products comprising wheat, potato, onion, fruits, fodder, honey, yellow corn, olive, and olive oil products, as well as animal products. In addition, the company engages in the cleaning and operation of factories, companies, buildings, and shops; and offers public, air conditioner, machinery, equipment, vehicle and device maintenance, and commercial services. Further, it is involved in the investment business, as well as operates healthcare facilities. The company retails its products and acts as an agent/distributor of various brand names, including Mont Blanc, Dunhill, Sarcar, Louis Erard, Saint Louis, Scintilla Monaco, Marina B, Talento, Rebecca, Robbe & Berking, Moser, Guy DeGrenne, Aynsley, Noritake, Nachtmann, Fratelli Rosetti, Derek Rose, Fabio Inghirami, Lanvin, Zimmerli, etc. It also exports its products. Fitaihi Holding Group was founded in 1907 and is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Jarir Marketing Company
summary: Jarir Marketing Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retail and wholesale trading of office and school supplies. It operates through Retail Outlets and Wholesale segments. The company sells office supplies, school supplies, books, computers and peripherals, computer supplies, smartphones and accessories, electronics, art and craft supplies, video games, smart TV's, and kids' development products, as well as after-sale services. It is also involved in the online sale of products through Jarir.com website and Jarir Bookstore app; and investment of office, retail, and residential properties. Jarir Marketing Company sells its products under the Jarir bookstore brand name. As of April 12, 2021, the company had 64 retail showrooms in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and other Gulf countries. Jarir Marketing Company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Abdullah Saad Mohammed Abo Moati Stationaries Company
summary: Abdullah Saad Mohammed Abo Moati Stationaries Company operates bookstores in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its stores offer stationery products and ink. As of April 26, 2021, the company operates 11 retail showrooms in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al-Saif Stores for Development & Investment Company
summary: Al-Saif Stores for Development & Investment Co. operates as an investment holding company. It also provides manufacture and sale of kitchen supplies and electrical appliances in the Kingdom, extending from the central region to the eastern, western and northern regions. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Al Taawun, Saudi Arabia.

name: Nice One Beauty Digital Marketing Company
summary: Nice One Beauty Digital Marketing Company functions as an online retail platform. It offers a diverse range of products for sale, including personal care items, fragrances, various textiles, clothing and footwear, leather accessories, electronic gadgets, and beauty products. The company primarily caters to consumers across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Marketing Home Group Company for Trading Company
summary: Marketing Home Group Company for Trading Company, established in 2005 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operates as a multifaceted trading enterprise across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the UAE, China, Spain, and Egypt. Its diverse operations encompass on-site construction of modular buildings and the refurbishment of both residential and commercial properties. The company is a significant wholesaler of various goods, including fragrant woods like agarwood and incense, perfumes, and a comprehensive range of building materials such as bricks, tiles, natural stone, marble, ceramics, porcelain, sanitary fixtures, water heaters, and storage tanks. Additionally, it conducts retail sales of sanitary ware (including sinks, chairs, bathtubs, and sauna equipment), electrical appliances, premium stone products, chandeliers, lighting solutions, and related accessories. Complementing its trading activities, the group manages warehousing services, performs marble cutting and fabrication to produce items like customized kitchens, sinks, antiques, basins, statues, sculptures, and paintings, and manufactures air conditioning ductwork along with their accessories.

name: Aldrees Petroleum and Transport Services Company
summary: Aldrees Petroleum and Transport Services Company engages in the wholesale and retail of fuel, gasoline, lubricant, and oil in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Petroleum Services and Transport Services segments. It operates approximately 544 fuel stations. The company offers various services related to additives, car wash, tire servicing, alignment, accessories, food, mosque, ATMs, car rental, etc. at its fuel stations. It also provides transportation and logistics services through a fleet of trucks and trailers. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Research and Media Group
summary: Saudi Research & Media Group engages in the provision of advertising, distribution, printing, publishing, and public relations services. It operates through the following segments: Publishing and Visual and Digital Content, Public Relations and Advertising, Printing and Packaging, and All Other. The Publishing and Visual and Digital Content segment comprises local and international publishing works, researches, and marketing the products of the group and third parties. The Public Relations and Advertising segment includes local and international public relation services, studies, research, marketing, media events, international advertising, production, representation and marketing audio visual and readable advertising media, and advertising panels. The Printing and Packaging segment refers to the printing works on paper and plastic, commercial posters, in addition to manufacturing of plastic products for the group and others. The All Other segment consists of wholesale and retail trading of school supplies, office furniture, installation and maintenance of laboratories, and providing technical, training and educational courses, services, international distribution of newspapers, magazines, publications, books, and the publications of the group and other related activities. The company was founded on July 1, 2000 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Emaar The Economic City
summary: Emaar The Economic City operates as a real estate development and management company in Saudi Arabia. The company primarily develops the King Abdullah Economic City. It also develops infrastructures; promotes, markets, and sells land within development areas; transfers/leases land; develops buildings/housing units; and constructs on behalf of other parties. In addition, the company develops, invests in, markets, sells/leases, operates, and maintains properties; and provides higher education services. Emaar The Economic City was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in King Abdullah Economic City, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Red Sea International Company
summary: Red Sea International Company is a global leader in the manufacturing and distribution of modular construction solutions. The company's expertise spans the development, construction, sale, and leasing of both residential and commercial properties. Its Industrial Housing division provides an extensive array of modular buildings designed for temporary or semi-permanent use across various industrial settings. These include essential facilities such as workforce accommodation, office spaces, kitchen and dining units, recreational centers, laundry amenities, labor quarters, drilling and rig camps, dormitories, security guardhouses, medical clinics and hospitals, hotels, emergency relief housing, schools, and religious edifices. The Affordable Housing division focuses on delivering diverse housing solutions and services to both private and public sector clients. These offerings can manifest as integrated master-planned communities or standalone residential neighborhoods, encompassing single-family homes, apartment complexes, or a hybrid of both. Additionally, the Building Materials division manufactures and supplies paints and coatings for industrial and residential applications. Beyond its primary construction activities, the company is involved in a range of complementary services. These include general contracting, facility maintenance, utility infrastructure development, civil engineering works, food catering services, the trade and supply of food products, and property investment and rental. Red Sea International Company caters to a broad spectrum of industries, including oil and gas, infrastructure, government, general building and construction, mining, defense, offshore operations, and manufacturing. The company boasts an international presence, with operations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Ghana, Papua New Guinea, Algeria, Malaysia, and other global markets. Founded in 1967 and based in Jubail, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, it operates as a subsidiary of Al Dabbagh Group Holding Company Limited.

name: AFG International Company
summary: AFG International Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale and retail of fashion apparels. It operates through three segments: Fashion Retail, Indoor Entertainment, and Food & Beverage. The Fashion Retail segment is involved in the sale of apparels, footwears, and accessories through retail outlets. The Indoor Entertainment segment operates kids play center. The Food & Beverage segment operates cafes and restaurants. The company has operations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, the Republic of Kazakhstan, the United States, the Republic of Azerbaijan, Georgia, Armenia, and Morocco. It operates approximately 1,842 stores across 100 shopping malls. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Jabal Omar Development Company
summary: Jabal Omar Development Company operates as a real estate development company in Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Operating Hotels, Commercial Centers, and Properties for Development and Sale segments. It engages in the investment, development, management, and sale of plots in the Jabal Omar project located in Makkah. It is also involved in the construction, maintenance, management, demolishing, surveying, furnishing hotels, commercial facilities, and staff residences, as well as operation of hotels. In addition, the company engages in importing and exporting hotel equipment and furniture. Jabal Omar Development Company operates hotels, including the Marriott, a five-star hotel with 426 rooms and suites; the Hilton Suites, a five-star hotel with 484 suites; the Hyatt Regency, a five-star hotel with 657 rooms and suites; and the Conrad, a five-star hotel with 438 rooms and suites; and Jabal Omar DoubleTree by Hilton with 676 rooms and suites. It also develops residential projects; and a commercial center. Further, the company provides logistic services. Jabal Omar Development Company was founded in 2006 and is based in Mecca, Saudi Arabia.

name: United International Transportation Company
summary: United International Transportation Company (UITC), operating through its subsidiaries, primarily focuses on vehicle leasing, rental, and pre-owned car sales in Saudi Arabia under the Budget Rent a Car brand. The company's business activities are structured across three segments: Lease, Rental, and Others. UITC provides a comprehensive suite of services, including short-term local and international rentals, long-term leasing, general car hire, chauffeur and limousine services, cross-border rental options, corporate fleet leasing, and loyalty programs for regular clients. Furthermore, its operations extend to the rental, leasing, and trading of heavy vehicles, equipment, and associated spare parts. Founded in 1978, UITC is headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Theeb Rent A Car Company
summary: Theeb Car Rental Company provides car rental services to individuals, governmental departments, and the private sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers long-term and short-term, cross border, limousine, and help on accident and road services, as well as cars for elders and special needs. It also sells cars; and operates maintenance centers. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Lumi Rental Company
summary: Lumi Rental Company is a prominent Saudi Arabian entity specializing in a broad spectrum of transportation and equipment services. Its core offerings include short-term smart vehicle and motorcycle rentals, alongside long-term leasing solutions tailored for both corporate and governmental organizations. The company extends its transportation expertise to include limousine services and bespoke transport packages for special occasions and events, as well as providing ground passenger transit within urban and suburban areas. Beyond its rental and leasing portfolio, Lumi is also active in vehicle sales, including new and pre-owned automobiles, along with the provision of vehicle parts and accessories. Comprehensive vehicle maintenance and repair services are also part of its operations. Further diversifying its business, Lumi engages in the rental of leisure, sports, and industrial machinery equipment, and operates as a tour provider. Established in 2007 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, the company adopted its current name, Lumi Rental Company, in 2019, having previously operated as Al Tayyar Rent a Car Limited. It functions as a subsidiary under the umbrella of Seera Holding Group.

name: SAL Saudi Logistics Services Co
summary: SAL Saudi Logistics Services Company, headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, delivers a comprehensive suite of cargo handling and logistics solutions across the Kingdom. Its operations are bifurcated into two core segments: Air Cargo Handling and Logistic Solutions. Under its Air Cargo Handling division, the company provides specialized services to air cargo carriers operating at Saudi Arabian airports. The Logistic Solutions segment offers extensive end-to-end services, encompassing customs clearance, warehousing, and meticulous inventory management. Additional provisions include ground transportation of goods, airport ground management and supervision, various other ground support services, the loading and unloading of air cargo aircraft, air cargo agency functions, and the efficient handling of air freight and mail. Established in 1945, SAL Saudi Logistics Services operates as a subsidiary of Saudi Arabian Airlines Corporation.

name: Flynas Co.
summary: Flynas Co. is a Saudi Arabian budget airline primarily focused on individual passenger transport through both regular and chartered flights. Additionally, the company provides a range of auxiliary services, including aircraft maintenance and repair, ground handling for cargo, engineering solutions, catering for flights, and various airport-related operations.

name: Cherry Trading Co.
summary: Cherry Trading Company, established in 1980 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is a diverse automotive and transportation enterprise. It primarily focuses on the buying and selling of new and pre-owned passenger vehicles, organized into its leasing, rental, and used car sales divisions. Beyond this core business, the company oversees vehicle maintenance facilities, provides public and educational transportation solutions, and offers real estate management for a fee. Its extensive operations also encompass passenger vehicle hire, the leasing, rental, and trade of heavy equipment and machinery, and the distribution of spare parts. Furthermore, Cherry Trading Company delivers logistics, warehousing, and a range of additional car services. The firm operates as a subsidiary of Saudi Edarah Holding Company.

name: Saudi Printing and Packaging Co.
summary: Saudi Printing & Packaging Co. engages in printing works, maintenance of printing projects, and establishing related factories and facilities. It operates through the following business segments: Printing, Packaging, and Other. The Printing segment includes printing works, related tools, and required raw material. The Packaging segment comprises of printing works on plastic and commercial labels, as well as plastic products. The Other Segment segment includes the head office, management's operations, investing activities, and others. The company was founded on May 28, 2006 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Kingdom Holding Company
summary: Kingdom Holding Company operates as a private equity investment firm, deploying capital across an exceptionally broad range of sectors. Its diverse portfolio spans financial services, real estate, luxury hospitality (including management), digital platforms, e-commerce, various investment funds, aviation, petrochemicals, media and publishing, entertainment, comprehensive healthcare services (provision, management, and consultancy), education, energy, manufacturing, consumer goods, retail, agriculture, social media, technology, and general industrial ventures. While its primary geographic focus is on Saudi Arabia and emerging markets throughout the Middle East and Africa, the firm also engages in international investments, notably within the United States. Established in 1980, Kingdom Holding Company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Khaleej Training and Education Company
summary: Al Khaleej Training and Education Company engages in the computer, language, education projects, financial and management training, communication centers, and schools businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company's Computer segment offers advanced programming, networking, and computer solutions to individuals and corporates. Its Language segment provides training courses in English language. The company's Education Projects segment offers educational projects to universities and the Ministry of Education, as well as operates orientation years for Saudi universities. Its Financial and Management Training segment provides management, leadership, stock trading, and other courses. The company's Communication Centers segment provides management and operating services for customer service centers through telephone for companies and bodies. Its School segment operates private educational schools for boys/girls. The company also offers training solutions for women hairdressers, beauty salons staff, students, cosmetic consultants, nutritionists, and fitness specialists through Formul'A Academy. In addition, the company provides lifeboat and fast rescue boat training, as well as management training solutions through New Dimension center. Further, it offers manpower and human resources to call centers and customer care services. Additionally, the company is involved in the establishment and construction of schools and cafeterias; installation of networks; provision of infrastructures, communication systems, operation and maintenance, and computer software, as well as online training and technical support services. It also provides franchise rights to various brands. Al Khaleej Training and Education Company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: National Company for Learning and Education
summary: The National Company for Learning and Education is dedicated to the ownership, establishment, and administration of educational institutions, from primary to secondary levels, throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its network of schools includes Al-Rayyan, Al-Rawabi, Al-Nuzha, Cordoba, Qassim, AL Ghad, Al Khwarizmi, Qairawan, and Doha Hills. Furthermore, the company invests in sports, entertainment activities, and athletic clubs designed for students. This entity was founded in 1958 and maintains its principal office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Ataa Educational Company
summary: Ataa Educational Company, an education company, engages in the establishment of kindergarten, primary, middle, and secondary schools for boys and girls in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Private Schools, International Schools, Indian Schools, and French Schools segments. It is also involved in the establishment, management, and operation and maintenance of computer training centers. Ataa Educational Company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company
summary: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company, together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in the development, sale, and lease of real estate projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates in two segments, Development Properties and Asset Management. It is involved in the acquisition, development, construction, management, operation, and maintenance of residential and commercial buildings, and public facilities. The company also engages in the purchase and sale, acquisition, and leasing of real estate investments; and purchase of land and general contracting activities. Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Knowledge Economic City Company
summary: Knowledge Economic City develops properties and other land in the economic cities of Saudi Arabia. It undertakes projects, including infrastructure, telecommunications and Internet networks, water and electricity networks, water treatment plants, and other works related to the development of the economic cities. The company also engages in the creation, operation, and management of educational projects; and development of software, scientific research centers, universities, colleges, institutes, and academies. In addition, its activities include marketing and selling real estate properties; buildings and land for development or for ownership of others; and managing housing services, tourist projects, resorts, hotels and furnished apartments, and other activities. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Medina, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Alandalus Property Company
summary: Alandalus Property Company engages in the commercial real estate investment and development activities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It constructs, owns, and manages centers, and commercial and residential complexes. The company is also involved in the general contracting of residential and commercial buildings, educational, recreational, health institutions, roads, dams, water and sewage project, electrical, and mechanical works. In addition, it engages in the leasing, maintenance, and operation of real estate properties, buildings, and commercial complexes, as well as ownership, development, and investment of lands and real estate properties. Alandalus Property Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabian Centres Company
summary: Arabian Centres Company develops, owns, and operates contemporary lifestyle centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates a portfolio of 21 lifestyle centers in 11 cities, which comprise approximately 4,300 retail stores. The company also builds, leases, and sells buildings; and engages in the construction of commercial buildings, including demolition, repair, excavation, and maintenance works. In addition, it is involved in the maintenance and operation of commercial centers, tourist resorts, hotels, and restaurants; and managing and operating temporary and permanent exhibitions, compounds, and hospitals. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Retal Urban Development Company
summary: Al-Khobar, Saudi Arabia-based Retal Urban Development Company, founded in 2012 as a subsidiary of Al Fozan Holding Company, operates as a comprehensive real estate entity across the Kingdom. Its core activities span the full property lifecycle, encompassing the construction, development, sale, leasing, brokerage, management, and ongoing maintenance of diverse real estate assets. The company's extensive portfolio features a wide array of residential projects, such as housing compounds, alongside various non-residential properties including educational institutions, healthcare facilities, hospitality venues, dining establishments, central marketplaces, and large-scale commercial and industrial complexes. Beyond direct property ventures, Retal provides broad general contracting services. This involves the construction of buildings for residential, commercial, public, educational, recreational, medical, and airport uses, including specialized precast structures. Their infrastructure capabilities extend to roads, dams, tunnels, and sewerage systems, complemented by a range of associated works such as electrical, mechanical, excavation, renovation, and climate control (HVAC) projects. Furthermore, the company is actively involved in the management and operation of factories, shopping malls, industrial sites, and infrastructure developments. They also oversee the upkeep of buildings, gardens, parks, and sports facilities, and engage in the acquisition, sale, and subdivision of land and investment properties. General cleaning services complete their service offerings.

name: Sumou Real Estate Company
summary: Sumou Real Estate Company engages in the development, management, maintenance, sale, and rental of residential and non-residential properties in Saudi Arabia. It also engages in the general building contracts, including construction, repair and renovation, and demolition for residential compounds, commercial centers, educational and entertainment, health and sports facilities, and hotels and restaurants; the provision of real estate project management services; and investment in real estate and project development. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. Sumou Real Estate Company is a subsidiary of Sumou Holding Company.

name: Banan Real Estate Co.
summary: Banan Real Estate Co. engages in the management and leasing of a range of commercial and residential real estate, and hotels. The company was founded on April 3, 2005 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Umm Al Qura for Development and Construction Co.
summary: Established in 2012 and based in Mecca, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Umm Al Qura for Development and Construction Company is primarily involved in the ownership, ongoing development, and operation of MASAR Destination, a substantial urban renewal project located in Makkah.

name: Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company
summary: Established in 1969, Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company is a Riyadh-based firm focused on property development within Saudi Arabia. The company's activities encompass the construction of both residential villas and commercial structures. In 2020, the organization transitioned to its current name, having formerly been known as Nasser and Abdulsalam Abdulrahman AlMajed Real Estate Company.

name: Alramz Real Estate Co.
summary: Established in 2016 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Alramz Real Estate Company specializes in the comprehensive development of both residential and commercial properties throughout the Kingdom. The firm manages the entire process from conceptual design and construction to the marketing of its diverse real estate portfolio, which encompasses individual villas, commercial units, and integrated mixed-use projects. A core aspect of its business involves acquiring land and transforming it into these various residential and commercial ventures. To further support its clientele, Alramz provides digital solutions including a mobile application for property maintenance, condition monitoring, and direct support, alongside an online portal for browsing listings, submitting inquiries, and facilitating transactions. Additionally, the company's operations extend into general contracting and professional property administration services.

name: Ladun Investment Company
summary: Ladun Investment Co. engages in the provision of real estate management and development services. Its activities include sale & purchase of land and real estate property, management & lease of owned or leased residential property, and real estate development for residential & commercial buildings using modern construction methods. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Riyad REIT Fund
summary: Riyad REIT specializes in real estate investing.

name: Aljazira Mawten REIT Fund
summary: Al - Jazira Mawten REIT Fund is a real estate investment trust managed by Al Jazira Capital Company, Asset Management Arm. The firm invests real estate markets of Saudi Arabia. It invests in income-generating property developments. The firm investments are mainly focused on the Jeddah-based Al-Khumra warehouses, which are wholly owned by AlJazira Mawten real estate income fund. Al - Jazira Mawten REIT Fund is based in Saudi Arabia.

name: Jadwa REIT Al Haramain Fund
summary: Jadwa REIT Al Haramain Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in income-generating real estate assets located in the vicinity of the Two Holy Mosques in Makkah and Madinah. The fund aims to provide investors with stable and recurring income from its portfolio of properties. Its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Taleem REIT Fund
summary: Taleem REIT Fund is a Shariah compliant real estate investment trust externally managed by Saudi Fransi Capital LLC. It invests in real estate markets of Saudi Arabia. The firm invests in constructionally developed real estates qualified to generate periodic return and rental income. Taleem REIT Fund was formed in May 30, 2017 and is based in Saudi Arabia. Taleem REIT Fund operates as a subsidiary of Saudi Fransi Capital LLC

name: Al Maather Reit Fund
summary: Al Maather Reit Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in a diversified portfolio of income-generating real estate assets across various sectors. The fund aims to provide investors with attractive returns through rental income and capital appreciation. Its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Musharaka REIT Fund
summary: Musharaka REIT Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in a diversified portfolio of income-generating real estate assets. The fund targets properties in the commercial, residential, and industrial sectors. Its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Mulkia Gulf Real Estate REIT
summary: Mulkia Gulf Real Estate REIT is a Shariah compliant real estate investment trust externally managed by Mulkia Investment Company. It invests in real estate markets of Saudi Arabia. The firm primarily invests in income generating real estates, which are under four specific real estate assets in major cities within Saudi Arabia. Mulkia Gulf Real Estate REIT Fund is based in Saudi Arabia.

name: Muscat Capital - Al Masha'ar REIT Fund
summary: Muscat Capital - Al Masha'ar REIT Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in income-generating real estate assets, focusing on properties in the hospitality sector located in Makkah and Madinah. The fund seeks to provide investors with attractive returns through rental income and capital appreciation. Its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Alahli Capital - Al-Ahli Reit Fund
summary: Alahli Capital - Al-Ahli Reit Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in a diversified portfolio of income-generating real estate assets across various sectors, including commercial, residential, and industrial properties. The fund aims to provide investors with stable and recurring income. Its headquarters are located in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Derayah Financial - Derayah Reit Fund
summary: Derayah Financial - Derayah Reit Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in a diversified portfolio of income-generating real estate assets. The fund targets properties in the commercial, residential, and hospitality sectors. Its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Rajhi REIT Fund
summary: Al Rajhi REIT Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in a diversified portfolio of income-generating real estate assets across various sectors, including commercial, residential, and hospitality properties. The fund aims to provide investors with stable returns. Its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Jadwa Investment - Jadwa Reit Saudi Fund
summary: Jadwa Investment - Jadwa Reit Saudi Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in a diversified portfolio of income-generating real estate assets across various sectors. The fund aims to provide investors with stable and recurring income from its portfolio. Its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: SEDCO Capital REIT Fund
summary: SEDCO Capital REIT is a Shariah-compliant real estate investment traded fund externally managed by SEDCO Capital. it invests in single-tenant and multiple-tenant properties across Saudi Arabia. SEDCO Capital REIT is based in Saudi Arabia.

name: Swicorp Wabel Reit Fund
summary: Swicorp Wabel Reit Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in a portfolio of income-generating logistics and warehousing properties. The fund aims to provide investors with stable returns and capital appreciation from its specialized portfolio. Its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: MEFIC REIT Fund
summary: MEFIC REIT Fund is a real estate investment trust. It aims to generate income on the invested capital by acquiring a number of recurring income-generating real estate assets. MEFIC REIT Fund’s portfolio includes residential, retail, hospitality, and office properties located in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Makkah, as well as Dubai in United Arab Emirates. The company was founded on February 18, 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Bonyan REIT Fund
summary: Bonyan REIT Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in a diversified portfolio of income-generating real estate assets. The fund's portfolio includes commercial, residential, and industrial properties. Its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Alkhabeer REIT Fund
summary: Alkhabeer REIT Fund is a real estate investment trust (REIT) in Saudi Arabia that invests in a diversified portfolio of income-generating real estate assets, primarily focusing on the commercial sector. The fund aims to provide investors with stable returns and capital appreciation. Its headquarters are located in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Alinma Hospitality REIT Fund
summary: The Fund's primary goal is to deliver consistent and increasing cash distributions to its unitholders. This objective is met through direct investments in mature, income-generating real estate assets. A significant emphasis is placed on properties within the hotel, hospitality, and tourism accommodation sectors. While the Fund may selectively invest in real estate development projects, a minimum of 75% of its total assets must consistently be held in developed properties that are actively generating rental income.

name: Alistithmar AREIC Diversified REIT Fund
summary: The Alistithmar AREIC Diversified REIT Fund functions as a real estate investment trust, with its primary base of operations located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Electricity Company
summary: Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) primarily handles the production, delivery, and distribution of electricity throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its clientele is diverse, spanning governmental bodies, industrial operations, agricultural enterprises, commercial establishments, and private households. Beyond its core power functions, SEC also builds, leases, manages, and operates both electrical and fiber optic networks to offer telecommunication services. The company further extends its activities into the financial realm, providing support for the issuance of bonds and sukuk, and engaging in various financing initiatives. Additionally, SEC is involved in managing construction projects, from developing detailed designs and procuring necessary materials to executing large-scale projects within the power sector. It also offers communication, data transmission, and information technology solutions to individuals, public institutions, and private organizations. Serving an estimated 10.1 million customers, the company was established in 2000 and has its headquarters located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd.
summary: Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd. produces, manufactures, and distributes food products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers Middle Eastern food products, such as sweets; meat products; breaded chicken and burgers; jams; dairy products; cheese; juices; provisions, such as olive oil, olives, peppers, and pickles; bakery products stuffed with dates, and packaging products. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Herfy Food Services Company
summary: Herfy Food Services Company establishes, operates, and franchises restaurants primarily in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company's restaurants offer cooked meals to companies and others. As of December 31, 2020, it owned 40 restaurants and leased 348 restaurants under the HERFY name in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company also franchises restaurants in Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, Egypt, and Bahrain; provides catering services; manufactures and sells meat products, as well as bakery and pastry, and sweets and chocolate products; and operates bakeries. In addition, it purchases and sells land for constructing buildings; and owns, uses, maintains, and leases stores and food store fridges. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Airlines Catering Company
summary: Saudi Airlines Catering Company offers catering and other support services to flights operated by Saudi Arabian and other airlines in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through three segments: Inflight, Retail, and Catering and Facilities. It offers in-flight catering services; and manages airport lounges. The company also provides SkySales, an in-flight shopping service; catering, accommodation management, laundry, and cleaning services to companies in remote sites; and on-platform and onboard catering services for passengers in rail terminals. In addition, it offers catering services to private sector firms and government offices, as well as hospitals and clinics; commercial laundry services to airlines, hotels, industrial operations, hospitals, and other clients; Hajj and Umrah catering services; and security services. Saudi Airlines Catering Company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: The National Agricultural Development Company
summary: Established in 1981 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, The National Agricultural Development Company (NADEC) is a significant player in agricultural and livestock production, with operations spanning the Kingdom and international markets. The company's activities extend to agricultural land reclamation, comprehensive food processing, and marketing its diverse range of products. Its extensive offerings include a wide variety of dairy items such as milk, yogurt, Laban, fresh cream, juices and drinks, desserts, cheeses, and butter. NADEC also provides olive oil, a selection of fruits like peaches, apricots, and plums, and common vegetables such as potatoes, onions, and tomatoes. Furthermore, the company cultivates various essential crops, including wheat, clover, Shami corn, Rhodes grass, olives, and alfalfa, alongside producing specialized nutritional fodder for its dairy cattle.

name: Raydan Food Co.
summary: Raydan Food Co. establishes, owns, operates, and manages restaurants. The company offers Arab meals, and cooked and uncooked catering services. It is also involved in the holding of concerts; management of factories; sale and purchase of livestock; sale and delivery of finished paintings; general contracting; real estate investment; import and export; and wholesale and retail trade activities. The company was formerly known as Raydan Co. Raydan Food Co. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Development Works Food Co. Ltd
summary: Development Works Food Co. Ltd operates within Saudi Arabia's dynamic food and beverage sector, overseeing a diverse portfolio of enterprises. This encompasses proprietary brands such as "Juice Time," which is recognized for its fresh juices and fruit salads, alongside managing various restaurants, coffee establishments, and specialized food preparation kiosks. The company also handles the importation of all crucial raw materials, supplies, and specialized equipment necessary for its wide-ranging operations. Established in 2010, its primary headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: AlAmar Foods Co.
summary: Alamar Foods Company, together with its subsidiaries, establishes, operates, and manages quick service restaurants in the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan. It operates restaurants under the Domino's and Dunkin' brands under franchisee agreements. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Alamar Foods Company is a subsidiary of Abdul Aziz Ibrahim Al Jammaz and Brothers Company.

name: Americana Restaurants International PLC
summary: Americana Restaurants International PLC is a prominent player in the food service industry, operating across the Middle East, North Africa, and Kazakhstan. The company oversees a diverse range of culinary establishments, including quick-service eateries, fast-casual dining spots, indulgent food concepts, casual restaurants, and coffee shops. Patrons can access these offerings through various service models, such as in-restaurant dining, takeaway options, convenient drive-thru and car-hop facilities, and direct home delivery. Founded in 1973, Americana Restaurants International PLC is headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, and operates as a subsidiary of Adeptio AD Investments LTD.

name: Shatirah House Restaurant Co.
summary: Shatirah House Restaurant Co. is a Saudi Arabian enterprise that manages a network of fast-casual dining venues under the Burgerizzr name. These establishments primarily feature a selection of beef and chicken burgers on their menu. The company currently oversees 65 operational restaurants. Established in 2009, its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Jahez International Company for Information Systems Technology
summary: Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Jahez International Company for Information Systems Technology is primarily recognized for its "Jahez" online food delivery platform, which operates across the Kingdom. The company structures its diverse operations into Delivery Platforms, Logistics Services, and an "Other" segments. Expanding beyond food, Jahez manages PIK, an e-commerce platform offering a variety of retail goods, including fashion, cosmetics, electronics, and hardware. It also runs LOGI, a dedicated last-mile delivery service that provides comprehensive logistical solutions. Furthermore, the company supports delivery-only restaurants through CO KITCHENS, a cloud kitchen concept that supplies commercial preparation spaces. Its service offerings extend to call center operations and a range of software-related services. Jahez is actively involved in an extensive array of additional commercial activities, such as general retail and wholesale trading, and the specialized retail of apparel, footwear, and leather items. In the technology sector, it designs, programs, and develops custom software; handles the import, wholesale, and retail of software; and sells computers along with accessories like printers and ink. The company also provides broader services in software development, database management, and application design. Its commercial reach further encompasses online consumer goods commerce and delivery, the operation of stores for refrigerated, frozen, and dry foods, and the supply of hygiene products. Additionally, wireless data services are part of its operational scope.

name: Sport Clubs Company
summary: Established in 1994 with its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Sport Clubs Company manages and operates a prominent network of fitness centers across the Kingdom. The company oversees a total of 54 gymnasiums, offering diverse fitness training programs and services. Its portfolio is segmented into 41 "Body Masters" branded clubs tailored for men, and 15 "Body Motions" clubs specifically designed for women. Beyond operating its fitness facilities, Sport Clubs Company also engages in the distribution of fitness equipment. The "Body Masters" clubs provide comprehensive amenities for men, including dedicated zones for cardio and strength training, various fitness studios, indoor cycling, functional training areas, football fields, swimming pools, spa services, adaptable personal training regimens, and martial arts spaces. Similarly, "Body Motions" clubs offer female members premium features such as cardio and strength equipment, fully appointed group exercise studios, indoor cycling, functional training zones, swimming pools, spa facilities, and flexible personal training options. Furthermore, the company extends its offerings through "Body Experts," specializing in corporate wellness solutions and event coordination.

name: Al Masar Al Shamil Education Co
summary: Operating across Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, Al Masar Al Shamil Education Co, officially known as Almasar Alshamil Education Company JSC, specializes in providing educational services. Its activities are segmented into two primary divisions: Higher Education, and Special Needs Education and Care. The company's operations encompass the management of special education and care centers, alongside clinics, and it delivers a range of offerings from degree programs to vocational training. Established in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in 2022, the entity underwent a name change in October 2024, transitioning from its former identity as Amanat Special Education and Care Investments LLC. Almasar Alshamil Education Co functions as a subsidiary of Amanat Special Education and Care Holdings Ltd.

name: Al Gassim Investment Holding Company
summary: Al Gassim Investment Holding Company invests in agriculture business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It engages in the manufacturing and selling of agricultural products; and import of seeds. The company was formerly known as Qassim Agriculture Company and changed its name to Al Gassim Investment Holding Co. in January 2017. Al Gassim Investment Holding Co. was founded in 1984 and is based in Jaradat al Buraykah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Armah Sports Co.
summary: Armah Sports Co. engages in the construction, operation, management, and maintenance of fitness clubs. It operates under the following brand concepts: Optimo and B_FIT. Optimo is a smart fitness club that is specifically designed for people seeking privacy, outstanding service, and a luxurious atmosphere. B_FIT offers a wide range of innovative tech-enabled solutions integrated with a premium fitness club offering. The firm operates through the Central Region and Western Region geographical segments. The company was founded by Abdul Mohsen Ali Mohammed Al-Hagbani, Fahad Ali Mohammed Al-Hagbani, Sulaiman Khaled Sulaiman Al-Kadi, and Abdulmalik Abdullah Mohammed Al-Hagbani on February 17, 2019 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Tabuk Agricultural Development Company
summary: Tabuk Agricultural Development Company produces and sells agricultural products in Saudi Arabia. It offers fruits; vegetables; alfalfa and wheat; and olive oil. The company also engages in the management and leasing of owned or leased properties. It sells its products under the TADCO brand. Tabuk Agricultural Development Company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.

name: Tabuk Agricultural Development
summary: Tabuk Agricultural Development Company focuses on agricultural production and processing activities. The company cultivates crops and engages in livestock farming in Saudi Arabia. They are headquartered in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Fisheries Company
summary: Saudi Fisheries Company engages in fishing, fish-farming, and marketing activities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company's seafood products include hareed, hamour baloul, zubaidi, shaour emperor, andak red sea bream, dennis seabream, qarous sea bass, hamor seaman, and nagel fish, as well as crab, peeled shrimp, lobster, squid, and salmon and knad steaks. It also offers meal products, including salmon grilled with rice, sweet sour shrimp with rice, tempura fish, fried prawns with potatoes, daqoos, flour, thome, green salad, spiced eggplant, rabban timbora, his sanctity, and chickpeas, as well as frozen shrimp. In addition, the company is involved in the operation of fish and shrimp farms; ice production and storage facilities; and operation and management of seafood restaurants. In addition, it engages in the sorting, cleaning, and chopping of fish, as well as preservation, cooking, and packing; and provision of logistic services, which include procurement, transportation, and warehouse of products. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Ash-Sharqiyah Development Co.
summary: Ash-Sharqiyah Development Co. operates as an agricultural enterprise with a presence in Saudi Arabia and international markets. Its core activities encompass the cultivation of vegetables, utilizing both traditional open-field methods and advanced greenhouse technology. The company further diversifies its portfolio through mixed farming practices and the innovative hydroponic production of vegetables. Beyond crop cultivation, it also undertakes the management of irrigation systems for various agricultural initiatives and participates in animal husbandry. Established in 1986, Ash-Sharqiyah Development Co. maintains its headquarters in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al-Jouf Agricultural Development Co.
summary: Al-Jouf Agricultural Development Co. specializes in the cultivation and distribution of diverse agricultural produce across Saudi Arabia. Its comprehensive product offerings encompass a variety of fruits, including peaches, apricots, nectarines, grapes, and plums, alongside fresh vegetables, ornamental plants, onions, potatoes, wheat, natural honey, and olive oils. Additionally, the company manages nurseries dedicated to growing seedlings for both fruit and olive trees. Founded in 1988, Al-Jouf Agricultural Development Co. maintains its principal office in Sakakah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Jazan Energy and Development Company
summary: Jazan Energy and Development Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the fisheries, agricultural, industrial, and real estate businesses in Saudi Arabia. The company is involved in the cultivation of mangoes and shrimps; preservation of fish and fish products; cooling and freezing of fruits; production and packaging and distributing of pure filtered water; operates hotels; and other activities. It engages in the buying, selling, and renting of land and real estate properties. Jazan Energy and Development Company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Jazan, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Telecom Company
summary: Saudi Telecom Company, together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications, information, media, and digital payment services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers mobile, landline, Internet, and TV on demand services, as well as international telecommunication, broadband, and other related services; and operates communications projects. It is also involved in the electrical business and telecommunication networks; and wholesale and retail of telecommunications equipment and electrical appliances, and recharge card services. In addition, the company engages in importing, marketing, installing, and maintaining licensed telecommunications and information technology; owning, constructing, operating, leasing, and commercializing telecom towers; the content services and digital media activities; the provision of computer services; the sale and re-sale of fixed and mobile telecommunication services; and the maintenance and operation of commercial centers. Further, it establishes, owns, develops, invests, and manages real estate and contracting activities; and provides consulting, and importing and exporting services. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Etihad Etisalat Company
summary: Etihad Etisalat Company operates mobile wireless telecommunication and fiber optic networks in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company manages, installs, and operates telephone networks, terminals, and communication unit systems; and sells and maintains mobile phones and communication unit systems. It is also involved in the contractual establishment and maintenance of wired telecommunication networks and related works; installation and maintenance of wire and wireless telecommunication networks; installation and maintenance of computer systems and the provision of data services; import, export, sale, and distribution of telecommunications hardware, software and systems, and intelligent building systems; and marketing and distribution of telecommunication services. In addition, the company provides computer services and related software and equipment; consultation services in the telecommunication, computer, software, and media production domains; and marketing and importing services for third parties. Further, it is involved in the wholesale, retail, maintenance, and operation of computers and electronic equipment, as well as the provision of related services. Additionally, the company invests funds in shares, bonds, and other securities; and owns real estate, as well as owns and leases intellectual property rights, such as patents and trademarks, concessions, and other intangible rights. Etihad Etisalat Company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Mobile Telecommunications Company Saudi Arabia
summary: Mobile Telecommunications Company Saudi Arabia offers a wide array of cellular communication services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its operations cover the entire lifecycle of mobile telephony, including the procurement, distribution, sale, installation, management, and upkeep of services and equipment. The company also extends its expertise to consulting, financial technology (fintech), and specialized technical drone services, in addition to providing general sales and repair solutions. Furthermore, it undertakes the construction and maintenance of telecom towers. Customers can access various mobile plans, such as postpaid, prepaid, and control packages, alongside dedicated options for Hajj and Omrah visitors. High-speed 4G and 5G internet services are available, complemented by a selection of mobile devices. Established in Riyadh in 2008, the company operates as a subsidiary of Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P.

name: Etihad Atheeb Telecommunication Company
summary: Etihad Atheeb Telecommunication Company provides voice and data services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers voice, data, value added and directory, and other future services and applications, as well as integrated business solutions. It offers dedicated internet acess, IP-VPN, VPN and IPLC, and VPN over LTE services; SIP trunk, national toll free, and UAN 9200 services; managed routers service and distributed denial of service; and co-location services. The company also provides fibre broadband, LTE broadband, and WiMAX broadband services; and prepaid calling cards to residential and personal customers. Etihad Atheeb Telecommunication Company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Moammar Information Systems Company
summary: Al Moammar Information Systems Company provides information technology solutions and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through six segments: Business Service Management unit, Solutions unit, Systems unit, Information Technology Security unit, Networking unit, and Operation and Maintenance unit. It provides operating systems, system analysis, and software design, programming, and maintenance, as well as web design and hosting, data processing services, and related services. The company also offers software-defined and coveraged storage; servers, such as server infrastructure management, racks and power infrastructure, racks and tower servers, mission-critical, blade system, and hyperscale; and software, including mobility, autonomy portfolio, big data and analysis, automation and cloud, app and desktop virtualization, application lifecycle management, data center and cloud management, desktop virtualization and mobile computing, and data center virtualization and cloud infrastructure. In addition, it provides networks and communication solutions based on SDN, NFV, automation, and management and orchestration technologies; geographic information services and various infrastructure solutions; and information technology security solutions to develop, deploy, and maintain security. Further, the company offers mainframe cost optimization, performance monitoring, remote support solutions, network management solution, IT business and service management, cloud computing, data center automation, data center infrastructure, management solutions, and data center capacity management solutions; and project management support for IT infrastructure business. It serves government, semi-government ministries, and private sectors. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Arab Sea Information Systems Company
summary: Arab Sea Information Systems Company, established in 1980 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, develops and markets a suite of integrated software solutions. These solutions cater to a diverse client base of commercial enterprises and government agencies, both within Saudi Arabia and globally. The company's product line features the "Saudi Administration and Accounting System," a dedicated business accounting program, and the "SCRIBES System," a comprehensive enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform engineered for medium and large-scale organizations. Furthermore, Arab Sea offers "e-Government Solutions," a specialized management system for warehouse administration and government sectors. Another key offering is the "3S System," a versatile solution for companies operating with various retail points, including supermarkets, apparel and footwear stores, pharmacies, drugstores, and spare parts suppliers. Beyond its software products, Arab Sea provides a full spectrum of support services, encompassing strategic consulting, project planning, professional installation, user training, and customized solution adaptation.

name: Arabian Internet and Communications Services Co. Ltd.
summary: Arabian Internet and Communications Services Co. Ltd. (7202.SR) is a prominent provider of comprehensive information technology solutions within Saudi Arabia. Established in 2002 and headquartered in Riyadh, the company operates as a subsidiary of Saudi Telecom Company. Its extensive range of services covers critical digital infrastructure and operational needs. These include expert system integration and network connectivity, managed services, business process outsourcing, and specialized digital offerings such as IoT and robust cybersecurity solutions. The company also delivers a full suite of cloud services, from colocation and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) to Software as a Service (SaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS). Further capabilities extend to the installation of computer networks and security devices, along with broader infrastructure maintenance, including road repair and supplies. STC Solutions provides strategic advisory to senior management, oversees training institutes, and specializes in computer system design, electronics provision, data center management, and both software and e-learning development. Its data expertise includes advanced analysis and management. Additionally, the company offers communication and internet services, general administrative and support functions, and human resources solutions encompassing direct recruitment, skills testing, and temporary employment agency services. It is also involved in the creation of electronic content and software production. STC Solutions caters to a diverse client base across numerous sectors, including healthcare, real estate, education, government, oil and gas, banking, and telecommunications.

name: Elm Company
summary: Headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Elm Company, established in 1986, specializes in delivering a diverse range of digital solutions, both off-the-shelf and bespoke, across the Kingdom. Its extensive offerings encompass IT and consulting services, government outsourcing, and comprehensive training programs. Additionally, the company develops specialized technical solutions and provides a suite of e-products tailored for security, transportation, health, and management applications, alongside digital outsourcing services. The entity, formerly known as Al-ELM Information Security Company, adopted its current name, Elm Company, in 2002.

name: Perfect Presentation for Commercial Services Company
summary: Perfect Presentation for Commercial Services Company, also known as 2P, is an ICT and technology solutions provider with operations spanning Saudi Arabia and international markets. Established in 2004 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, the company delivers a comprehensive portfolio of services. Its core offerings include custom software development, covering web and mobile applications, alongside advanced decision support systems. 2P also specializes in customer experience solutions, implementing tracking technologies and managing outsourced contact centers. Furthermore, the company provides vital operational support, system maintenance, IT outsourcing, and managed services. The firm has developed several proprietary platforms, such as Perfect Engage, a messaging application equipped with integrated audio and video calling; Yamamah, an application-to-person communication platform; and Contracting Business ERP, a system designed for efficient resource management within businesses. Beyond these, 2P offers a diverse range of digital media services, including tailored SMS packages on various subjects like culture, sports, and news. They operate gooolonline.com, a dedicated online sports newspaper, and tanmiah.cc, a website focused on self-development, featuring online tests and courses in personal, managerial, and family growth. Their e-commerce capabilities extend to bulk SMS services and online shopping solutions, complemented by e-payment services that integrate with the SADAD Payment System, facilitating electronic bill presentment and payment across Saudi Arabia's commercial sector. Additionally, 2P implements a suite of enterprise solutions, including application performance management, business intelligence, business activity monitoring, system integration, and various contact center (voice and web) and CRM products.

name: Dar AlBalad for Business Solutions Company
summary: Dar AlBalad for Business Solutions Company offers a wide array of information technology (IT) consulting and solution services. The firm ensures a smooth and effective digital environment through its comprehensive support offerings, which include constant monitoring, system upkeep, troubleshooting, and assistance for end-users, service desks, applications, and infrastructure. Additionally, the company delivers business-managed services, covering supply chain optimization, administrative processes, and logistics. It also specializes in providing complete solutions for the Internet of Things (IoT), from device procurement and installation to ongoing management. Their clientele spans various sectors, such as technology and telecommunications, insurance and healthcare, government and utilities, and financial institutions. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Dar AlBalad for Business Solutions Company operates as a division of Dar AlBalad Commercial Company.

name: Saudi Azm for Communication and Information Technology Company
summary: Operating alongside its subsidiaries, Saudi Azm for Communication and Information Technology Company delivers a broad spectrum of business and digital technology solutions across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its comprehensive offerings encompass institutional services such as operational assistance for significant governmental and private organizations, system integration, procurement management, and human resources solutions. Additionally, it furnishes management consulting, covering strategic advice and guidance on operating models. The firm is also involved in developing innovative products and creating specialized platforms for the financial technology sector, among others. Its platform development services span the entire lifecycle, from design and construction to ongoing operation, specifically including initiatives like public partnership projects. Moreover, the company designs and programs software, develops applications, and specializes in user experience (UX) and customer journey design. It also offers repair and maintenance services for personal and portable computers. The company oversees the sales management and control of both wired and wireless communication equipment and devices. Executive-level consulting forms another part of its portfolio, alongside services related to information networks and technological research and development. Established in 2017, Saudi Azm for Communication and Information Technology Company maintains its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: The Company for Cooperative Insurance
summary: The Company for Cooperative Insurance provides various insurance and reinsurance solutions for individuals and companies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Medical, Motor, Property and Casualty, Protection and Saving, and Manafeth segments. The company offers motor, medical, property and casualty, takaful, engineering and contractors, industrial and energy, telecommunications and IT, financial and investment, transportation, retail and trading, fire, marine, aviation, liability, energy, general accidents, home, international travel, medical malpractice, shop owners, and protection and savings insurance products. It also provides third party liability insurance for foreign vehicles. The company was formerly known as National Company for Cooperative Insurance and changed its name to The Company for Cooperative Insurance in 2004. The Company for Cooperative Insurance was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Aljazira Takaful Taawuni Company
summary: Aljazira Takaful Taawuni Company provides various insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its Individual segment offers life insurance products, which include unit linked investment-oriented products on an individual basis. The Company's Group segment provides life protection programs to the members of organizations on a group basis, as well as credit protection benefits in respect of personal loan given by financing organization. This segment also includes protection benefits in respect of various credit facilities other than personal loans extended by the financing organizations to its customers. The company was founded in 2013 is based in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Malath Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Malath Cooperative Insurance Company provides insurance products and related services to individuals and businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Medical, Motor, Property & Casualty, and Protection & Savings segments. It offers marine cargo in transit and ships against marine perils insurance products; engineering insurance that provides coverage for loss or damage to construction works or erection and installation of plant and machinery; and health, motor vehicles, fire and burglary, public liability, personal accident, and workmen compensation insurance products. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: The Mediterranean and Gulf Cooperative Insurance and Reinsurance Company
summary: The Mediterranean and Gulf Cooperative Insurance and Reinsurance Company provides insurance and reinsurance products and related activities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers motor third party liability and comprehensive motor insurance products, as well as group health insurance products. The company also provides protection and savings, travel, property, engineering, contractors' all risks, machinery breakdown, stock deterioration, contractors' equipment, erection all risks, electronic device, aviation and air transport, money, comprehensive bank, fidelity, personal accidents, professional and product liability, workers' compensation and employer liability, marine cargo, and marine hull insurance products. The Mediterranean and Gulf Cooperative Insurance and Reinsurance Company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Allianz Saudi Fransi Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Allianz Saudi Fransi Cooperative Insurance Company provides insurance products to corporate and individual customers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers motor, travel, medical, engineering, employee benefits, credit, fidelity guarantee, and protection and savings insurance, as well as property and casualty insurance, such as fire, burglary, money, construction/erection works, liability, and marine. The company was formerly known as Saudi Fransi Cooperative Insurance Company and changed its name to Allianz Saudi Fransi Cooperative Insurance Company in October 2010. Allianz Saudi Fransi Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Salama Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Salama Cooperative Insurance Company provides insurance products and services in the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Algeria, Malaysia, Bahrain, Senegal, and Egypt. It operates through three segments: Medical, Motor, and Others. It offers motor insurance products that cover accident, fire, towing, malicious, theft, estimation, and medical expenses; and medical insurance for care, medicines, chronic diseases, vaccination, maternity and neonatal, physiotherapy, ophthalmology, dental care, oncology, and CCHI. The company also provides travel insurance comprising personal accidents, medical expenses, repatriation of mortal remains, lost baggage, passport loss, cash loss, personal liability, and accidental death; and malpractice insurance that provides specialties, flexible, and medical facilities coverage. In addition, it offers general insurance coverage, such as engineering, liability, marine, property, and general accident insurance products. The company was formerly known as Saudi IAIC Cooperative Insurance Company and changed its name to Salama Cooperative Insurance Company in 2012. Salama Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Walaa Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Walaa Cooperative Insurance Company provides cooperative insurance and reinsurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers various property insurance products, including property all risk, fire and specified perils property damage, home, and loss of profit/business interruption insurance; and engineering insurance products, such as erection and construction all-risk, and contractor's plant and machinery/equipment insurance, as well as machinery breakdown insurance (MBD), loss of profit following MBD, and deterioration of stock following MBD. The company also provides motor insurance products, which include commercial and private motor comprehensive, and third party liability policies; marine insurance products, including marine cargo and hull insurance policies; medical insurance; and miscellaneous accidents insurance products, such as comprehensive general liability, professional indemnity, medical malpractice, directors and officers liability, privacy and network security cyber liability, fidelity guarantee, money, personal accident, workmen's compensation and employers liability, travel, aviation hull, and public and product liability insurance. The company was formerly known as Saudi United Cooperative Insurance Company and changed its name to Walaa Cooperative Insurance Company in May 2017. Walaa Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Al-Khobar, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company offers various insurance products to companies and individuals in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers medical, motor, property, engineering, marine, liability, accident, casualty, protection and saving, travel, and medical malpractice insurance, as well as reinsurance products. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: SABB Takaful Company
summary: SABB Takaful Company provides a range of family and general insurance products to individual and corporate customers primarily in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through three segments: Individual Family Takaful, Group Family Takaful, and General Takaful. The company offers various protection plans, including travel, home, and personal accident takaful products; and wealth management plans consisting of investment, saving, education, and retirement takaful products. It also provides business protection products comprising marine cargo, business interruption or loss of profit, public liability, keyman protection, fire-property all risks, group creditors, SME package, fidelity guarantee, and money takaful plans; and employee benefits products, including group personal accident and care plans. The company was founded in 2006 is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Arabian Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Saudi Arabian Cooperative Insurance Company engages in the insurance business in Saudi Arabia. The company provides group medical and life, motor and vehicle, power, aviation, fire, marine, engineering, hull and goods, property, and liability insurance products, as well as protection and savings insurance products. It serves corporates, SMEs, and individuals. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Indian Company for Cooperative Insurance Wafa Insurance
summary: Saudi Indian Company for Cooperative Insurance Wafa Insurance provides general insurance, health insurance, and protection and savings products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Motor, Health, and Other segments. It offers property, accident, and liability insurance comprising fire, property damage, business interruption, personal accident, fidelity, money, theft and burglary, comprehensive general liability, workmen's compensation, medical malpractice, and medical insurance products; comprehensive and third party motor insurance products; and marine cargo insurance products. The company's products also include engineering insurance, such as machinery breakdown, contractor's all risk, contractor's plant and machinery, erection all risks, and electronics equipment insurance products; medical insurance; individual protection and saving products; and individual and group protection plans, as well as a range of reinsurance products and services. Saudi Indian Company for Cooperative Insurance Wafa Insurance is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company provides various insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Medical; Motor; Property and Casualty; and Protections and Savings segments. The company offers out-patient clinic treatment charges, property, marine cargo, third party liability, burglary, and group life and accident insurances; and individual insurances, including auto and health insurances, as well as reinsurance services. Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Dammam, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: AlAhli Takaful Company
summary: AlAhli Takaful Company provides protection and saving insurance products through insurance solutions for individuals and groups in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates in two segments, Insurance-Individual and Insurance-Group Life. The Insurance-Individual segment offers life insurance products on an individual basis, including unit linked investment-oriented products.
