The Insurance-Group Life segment provides life protection programs to the members of organizations on a group basis; and credit's protection benefits in respect of personal loan given by financing organization. This segment also offers protection benefits in respect of various credit facilities other than personal loans extended by the financing organizations to its customers. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Allied Cooperative Insurance Group
summary: Allied Cooperative Insurance Group engages in cooperative insurance operations and related activities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates in four segments: Motor Insurance, Medical Insurance, General Accident Insurance, and Others. It provides motor comprehensive and third-party liability, medical, travel, home, shop, and visitor insurance products; general accident insurance products, such as money, fidelity guarantee, business all risk, business travel, and exhibition insurance; and liability insurance products, such as general third-party liability, product liability, workmen's compensation/employer's liability, and professional indemnity. The company also offers engineering insurance products comprising deterioration of stocks, machinery breakdown, electronic equipment, contractor's all risks, erection all risks, and loss of profit following machinery breakdown; and property all risks and fire insurance policies. In addition, it offers medical malpractice, personal accident, and medical and marine insurance products. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabia Insurance Cooperative Company
summary: Arabia Insurance Cooperative Company provides insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers motor, health, property, engineering, medical, general accident, fire, marine, and other insurance products, such as general and aviation, as well as protection and savings insurance. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Al-Etihad Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Al-Etihad Cooperative Insurance Company provides insurance services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers property, motor, marine and marine cargo, medical and health, general accident and liability, casualty, and engineering and construction insurance. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Dhahran, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Sagr Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Al Sagr Cooperative Insurance Company provides insurance products and solutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Singapore. The company operates through Medical, Motor, Property and Casualty, and Protection and Savings segments. It offers fire and allied perils, property all risks, and business interruption insurance products; marine cargo and hull insurance products; and engineering insurance products comprising contractor's all risks and erection all risks, contractors' plant and machinery, machinery breakdown, loss of profit due to machinery breakdown, boiler and pressure vessels, deterioration of stock, and electronics equipment insurance. The company also provides liability insurance products, such as workmen's compensation, employer liability, public liability, and professional indemnity insurance; onshore and offshore energy insurance products; and medical, travel, motor, and medical malpractice insurance products. In addition, it offers miscellaneous insurance products, including personal accident, money, fidelity guarantee, and burglary insurance. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Dammam, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Re for Cooperative Reinsurance Company
summary: Saudi Re for Cooperative Reinsurance Company provides various reinsurance products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, rest of the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and internationally. The company underwrites engineering, property, marine, casualty, motor, retro, life, medical, fire, general accident, term and credit life, aviation, energy, agriculture, and political risk reinsurance products; and various reinsurance products for Takaful industry. Saudi Re for Cooperative Reinsurance Company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Bupa Arabia for Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Bupa Arabia for Cooperative Insurance Company underwrites medical insurance products for businesses and families in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It issues short-term insurance contracts for providing health care services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Rajhi Company for Cooperative Insurance
summary: Al Rajhi Company for Cooperative Insurance provides various insurance products and services to individuals, SMEs, and corporates in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates in four segments: General, Motor, Health, and Protection and Savings. It offers motor, unified health, domestic helper, travel, medical malpractice, visitor visa, personal accident, and home owners, as well as general insurance products, such as property all risks, workers injury compensation and employer's liability, fidelity guarantee, and public business liability. The company also provides liability, contractors risk, marine cargo, plant machinery, machinery breakdown, and erection all risk insurance products; and protection and savings products, such as education, marriage, retirement, and investment insurance policies. It is also involved in the re-insurance and agency activities. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Chubb Arabia Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Chubb Arabia Cooperative Insurance Company operates as a multiline property and casualty insurer in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers property and casualty insurance products comprising property all risks, fire and allied perils, business interruption, householders', terrorism and sabotage, burglary and housebreaking, general liability, workmen's compensation and employer's liability, motor, plate glass, money, crime, fidelity guarantee/employee dishonesty, and travel insurance products. It also provides engineering insurance products comprising contractors all risk, erection all risks, machinery breakdown, business interruption due to machinery breakdown, and computer/electronic data processing, as well as machinery, plant, and equipment all risks insurance products. In addition, the company offers marine cargo, project cargo and DSU, inland transit, and marine hull insurance products; group life and group personal accident insurance products; and financial insurance products, such as bankers blanket bond, financial institutions professional indemnity, civil liability for financial institutions, electronic and computer crime, fraud protector, financial services industry insurance policy, and directors and officers liability insurance. It serves multinational corporations and local businesses, companies, and affinity groups. Chubb Arabia Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Al Khobar, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: AXA Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: AXA Cooperative Insurance Company provides various insurance and reinsurance products for individuals, SME, and business in Saudi Arabia. The company offers car, travel, home, personal accident, and SME fleet and health care insurance; and business insurance, including motor fleet, healthcare, business travel shield, marine, and group personal accident insurance, as well as visa extension services. It also provides money, business all risk, life, general third-party liability, product liability, workmen's compensation/employer's liability, contractors all risk, erection all risk, machinery and electronic equipment failure, death, and disability insurance. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Gulf General Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Gulf General Cooperative Insurance Co. engages in the provision of general insurance services. It operates through the following segments: Medical, Motor, Property, Engineering, Marine, and Accident and Liability. The Medical segment provides compensation to policy holders for expenses incurred in treatment of a disease, illness, or injury. The Motor segment offers coverage against losses and liability related to motor vehicles. The Property segment is involved in losses related to fire, natural perils, business interruption, and burglary. The Engineering segment focuses on damage brought about by erection or construction of civil engineering works and installation of plants and machinery. The Marine segment includes damages and liabilities arising through loss damage to marine cargo hull. The Accident and Liability segment covers money, fidelity guarantee, personal accident, jeweler block, jewelry all risks, and travel insurance and liability insurance provide coverage against the insured’s legal liability arising out of acts of negligence during their business operations. The company was founded on December 16, 2009 and is headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Buruj Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Buruj Cooperative Insurance Company provides various general insurance products to individuals and business entities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through five segments: Motor Insurance, Medical Products, Property, Marine Products, and Others. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Alamiya for Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Al Alamiya for Cooperative Insurance Company engages in the insurance and reinsurance businesses primarily in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates in six segments: Property, Motor, Engineering, Medical, Marine, Group Life, and Others. It offers car, travel, home, and personal accident insurance products; and small and medium business, motor fleet, property, marine, engineering, life, workmen's compensation, liability, and general accident insurance products. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Al Alamiya for Cooperative Insurance Company is a subsidiary of Royal and Sun Alliance Insurance (Middle East) BSC(c).

name: Wataniya Insurance Company
summary: Wataniya Insurance Company provides a range of insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Marine, Property, Motor, Engineering, Accident & Liability, Extended Warranty, and Term Life segments. It offers various insurance products, such as motor insurance; general accident and casualty insurance products, including fidelity guarantee, money, personal accident, public liability, work injury, medical malpractice, burglary, glass breakage, business all risk, business travel, and exhibition insurance products; and liability insurance includes general third-party liability, product liability, workmen's compensation/employer's liability, and professional indemnity. The company also provides marine cargo insurance products, which include land transit, marine cargo, and marine hull insurance; employee benefits insurance; and engineering insurance products comprising contractor all risk, construction, mechanical, electrical, contractors' plant and machinery, electronic equipment, erection all risk, machinery breakdown, and deterioration of stock insurance. In addition, it offers property insurance products comprising property all risk, fire and lightning, household comprehensive, and terrorism risk insurance; extended warranty coverage against damages to motor vehicles; and term life coverage against the insured's death. The was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Amana Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Amana Cooperative Insurance Company provides various insurance products and services to corporate and individual clients in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers engineering, fidelity, general, healthcare, marine cargo, money, motor, personal, property, travel, and workmen insurance products, as well as other specialized insurance solutions. Amana Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Enaya Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Saudi Enaya Cooperative Insurance Company provides health insurance services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It primarily underwrites medical insurance products for group and individual clients. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Alinma Tokio Marine Company
summary: Alinma Tokio Marine Company provides various insurance products and services to individuals and corporates in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Property and Casualty, Motor, Protection and Savings, and Medical segments. The company offers insurance products in the areas of protection and savings programs; motor; and fidelity guarantee, commercial general liability, trade credit, personal accident, money, bankers blanket bond, hauliers and public liability, and workers compensation. It also provides business interruption, fire and special perils, home package, and property all risk insurance products; health insurance products; marine cargo and cargo voyage risks insurance products; and boiler and pressure vessel, contractor's all risk, contractors' plant and machinery insurance, deterioration of stock in cold storage, electronic equipment, erection all risks, loss of profits following machinery breakdown, and machinery insurance. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Rasan Information Technology Co.
summary: Rasan Information Technology Company operates as a FinTech enterprise, delivering a comprehensive suite of insurance and financial services to both individual consumers and corporate clients via its digital platforms. Key offerings include Tameeni, which facilitates comparing, purchasing, and renewing insurance policies from a network of providers; Treza, an insurance solution specifically tailored for motor leasing companies and their clientele; Awalmazad, an online auction platform for salvaged and repossessed vehicles, serving insurance and leasing firms; and Warshti, a dedicated car repair service. Established in 2016, the company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: National Building and Marketing Co.
summary: National Building and Marketing Co. is a Saudi Arabian enterprise primarily involved in the wholesale and retail distribution of construction materials. Its extensive product portfolio includes foundational building components such as iron and timber, alongside a diverse range of items like electronic devices, office supplies (including stereotypes and desktops), and specialized medical provisions (scientific equipment, hospital essentials, laboratory apparatus, and medical furniture). Additionally, the company extends its expertise to construction and general contracting, undertaking projects for buildings and aesthetic enhancements. Further offerings encompass paints, various chemicals, and promotional merchandise. Established in 1990, the company's operations are headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Sumou Real Estate Company
summary: Sumou Real Estate Company engages in the development, management, maintenance, sale, and rental of residential and non-residential properties in Saudi Arabia. It also engages in the general building contracts, including construction, repair and renovation, and demolition for residential compounds, commercial centers, educational and entertainment, health and sports facilities, and hotels and restaurants; the provision of real estate project management services; and investment in real estate and project development. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. Sumou Real Estate Company is a subsidiary of Sumou Holding Company.

name: Riyadh Cement Co.
summary: Saudi White Cement Company manufactures, produces, and markets various types of clinker and cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

name: Watani Iron Steel Co.
summary: Watani Iron Steel Co. manufactures and sells various steel products in Saudi Arabia. The company offers rebar, wire rod, and other steel products used in construction and infrastructure projects. It is headquartered in Saudi Arabia.

name: Mohammed Hasan AlNaqool Sons Co.
summary: Mohammed Hasan AlNaqool Sons Co. is a company listed on the Saudi Arabian Stock Exchange under the ticker 9514. It operates in the Construction Materials industry within the Materials sector. The company is headquartered in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

name: Fesh Fash Snack Food Production Company
summary: Fesh Fash Snack Food Production Co. engages in the production and marketing of snack food products. It offers corn curls, natural potato chips, and pellets. The company was founded on April 26, 1981 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Natural Gas Distribution Company
summary: This Saudi Arabian company specializes in the pipeline distribution of natural gas. It is also responsible for the operation, maintenance, and repair of these gas pipeline networks. A core aspect of its service includes providing dry gas to industrial clients, specifically factories located within Riyadh's second industrial city. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: MOBI Industry Co.
summary: Established in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in 1981, MOBI Industry Co. operates as a prominent manufacturer and distributor across diverse chemical sectors within the Kingdom. While primarily known for its agricultural offerings, which include a comprehensive range of nitrogen, phosphate, and potash fertilizers, alongside other nitrogen compounds, the company's portfolio extends significantly beyond this. It also produces various household and industrial goods. These encompass plastics, insect and rodent control products, and a wide array of cleaning solutions such as floor, glass, and furniture polishes, as well as scouring powders. MOBI also supplies room fresheners and odor-neutralizing preparations. Its consumer product line further includes soaps and shampoos, complementing its industrial-grade detergents and other washing and cleaning materials. Many of these items are marketed under the company's well-known Mobi and Shot brands. Additionally, MOBI Industry Co. engages in plastic bottle manufacturing. The company rebranded to its current name in November 2022, having previously operated as National Fertilizer Company Ltd.

name: Inmar Company for Real Estate Development and Investment
summary: Inmar Company for Real Estate Development and Investment is actively involved in property investment and development throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The firm undertakes projects across a broad spectrum of sectors, encompassing commercial, residential, industrial, mixed-use, and educational developments. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Alhasoob Co.
summary: Alhasoob Co., officially known as Al Hasoob Trading Company, operates as a key online retailer specializing in computing equipment and related parts across Saudi Arabia. The firm provides an extensive selection of products, encompassing core hardware such as laptops, desktop computers, and servers, alongside a wide range of peripherals and components. Their comprehensive inventory features diverse storage solutions like HDDs, SSDs, and flash drives; various input devices including keyboards and mice; and numerous output devices such as printers, plotters, projectors, and a variety of monitors, including gaming-specific models. Additionally, they supply essential internal components like RAM and batteries, networking products, and audio accessories such as headphones and speakers. The company's offerings also extend to software applications and consumables like ink, toners, and ribbons, along with a host of other related accessories. Founded in 1989, Alhasoob Co. is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Group Five Pipe Saudi Ltd.
summary: Established in 2001, Group Five Pipe Saudi Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of spirally welded pipes throughout the Middle East. The company operates from its headquarters in Dammam, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Advance International Company for Communication and Information Technology
summary: Advance International Company for Communication and Information Technology provides security and technology solutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It imports, sells, installs, operates, and maintains security surveillance cameras, baggage and parcel inspection devices, security fences, biometric magnetic card entry and exit gates, anti-theft alarm devices and systems, metal and explosive detection gates, electronic business, communications and network technology, and computer software. In addition, it provides crowd management, smart attendance management, hotel management, security inspection, attendance management, CCTV surveillance camera, vehicle parking management, banking, healthcare, entertainment, logistics, real estate, industry, information technology, and retail solutions, as well as security solutions for educational institutions, and ICT services. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Alf Meem Yaa for Medical Supplies and Equipment Company
summary: Ame Company For Medical Supplies operates as a distributor and marketer of medical products specifically designed for the aesthetic market throughout Saudi Arabia. Its comprehensive product catalog features a variety of key offerings, including Teoxane, a line of injectable hyaluronic acid-based dermal fillers formulated to reduce wrinkles on the face and neck. The company also provides advanced medical laser systems, innovative therapeutic solutions, and various botulinum products. Furthermore, their portfolio encompasses Magellan, an autologous concentration system for delivering focused platelets and cells at the point of care, as well as MINT, an absorbable polydioxanone barbed suture used for soft tissue approximation. Established in 2005, the firm is headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabian International Healthcare Holding Company
summary: Arabian International Healthcare Holding Company engages in distribution and maintenance of medical, devices, imaging equipment, prosthetics, dental and veterinary equipment, and cosmetic products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through three segments: Medical Devices, Medical Supplies, and Clinical & Pharmaceutical. It offers various products for cardiology, intensive care, oncology, rehab, infection prevention technologies, hospital infrastructure, gene sequencing laboratory, anesthesia machines, hospital beds and medical furniture, lab furniture solution, biobanking solution, hospital information technology, surgical rooms solutions, laboratories, and ventilation system. The company also provides its products for orthopedics, management delivery solutions, catheters and syringes, and vein thrombosis prevention. In addition, it offers medical services at clinics; and sells health and beauty related medicines. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Aljouf Mineral Water Bottling Co.
summary: Established in 1983, Aljouf Mineral Water Bottling Co. specializes in the manufacturing and packaging of wholesome drinking water in plastic containers throughout Saudi Arabia. The company's headquarters are situated in Riyadh.

name: Saudi Parts Center Company
summary: Saudi Parts Center Company Limited, a subsidiary of the Alkhorayef Group Company, serves the Saudi Arabian market as a prominent wholesaler and retailer of spare parts. The company supplies components for a broad spectrum of applications, including motor vehicles, marine vessels, industrial machinery, and heavy equipment. Its extensive product catalog encompasses performance-enhancing items such as intercoolers, blow-off valves, external wastegates, piping elements, and boost controllers. Additionally, it offers critical functional parts like engine components, cooling systems, seals, gaskets, undercarriage products, turbochargers, bearings, filters, pumps, ground engaging tools (G.E.T. parts), hydraulic and electrical systems, steering clutches, and brakes. The inventory further extends to hardware, transmission, fuel injection, power train, and frame and body components, along with various specialized products for motorsports. Established in 1988, the company's operations are based out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabian Food & Dairy Factories Company
summary: Arabian Food & Dairy Factories Company, an affiliate of HAK Holding Company, is a Dammam, Saudi Arabia-based enterprise established in 1979. It specializes in manufacturing and distributing diverse ice cream selections across the Kingdom, offering them to consumers under its Fadeco and Blumark labels.

name: Amwaj International Company
summary: Amwaj International Company is dedicated to the distribution and sale of a broad spectrum of electronic and home appliances. Its comprehensive product offerings encompass essential household items such as air conditioning units, televisions, washing and drying machines, water coolers, refrigerators, freezers, stoves, various cooking appliances, heaters, and numerous other domestic devices. Founded in 2001, the company is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and functions as a subsidiary of Zahran Holding.

name: Naseej for Technology Co.
summary: Naseej for Technology Co. specializes in providing comprehensive digital transformation services, primarily focusing on the learning and knowledge management sectors. The company's extensive portfolio includes solutions for campus administration, e-learning platforms, talent development, library automation, and systems tailored for museums and archives. Additionally, Naseej provides business intelligence tools, advanced knowledge management systems, digitization and cataloging expertise, a range of e-solutions, curated knowledge and information resources, RFID technology for libraries, and strategic consulting services. Their diverse clientele encompasses government entities, public and private sector organizations, and various cultural and information centers. Established in 1989, the company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Aqaseem Factory for Chemicals and Plastics Co.
summary: Aqaseem Factory for Chemicals and Plastics Co. specializes in the production and supply of a diverse array of oils and lubricants. The firm's extensive product portfolio encompasses a full range of automotive lubricants, including formulations for gasoline, diesel, and motorcycle engines, alongside gear oil, automatic transmission fluids, and brake fluids. Catering to industrial demands, Aqaseem provides specialized oils such as turbine, heat transfer, cutting, slide way, circulating, compressor, and hydraulic lubricants. Additionally, its offerings extend to marine lubricants and various types of greases. Founded in 1997, the company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and maintains a significant operational presence throughout Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, and Palestine.

name: National Environmental Recycling Company
summary: Based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, National Environmental Recycling Co. commenced operations in 2015. This firm specializes in the reclamation and processing of electronic and electrical apparatus across the Middle East and North African territories.

name: Academy of Learning Co.
summary: Academy of Learning Co. operates in the education and training sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia through educational and training institutes in various regions. It qualifies its students for the labor market by providing more practical experience through a number of accredited diploma programs. The company was founded on December 27, 2004 and is headquartered in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

name: Keir International Co.
summary: Keir International Co., established in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in 2008, delivers a broad spectrum of service solutions. The company caters to the information technology and communications sector, alongside vital public utility industries such as power and electricity generation, water, gas, and petroleum. Its offerings span the entire project lifecycle, from implementation and execution to ongoing operation, maintenance, trading, and supply. The firm provides specific solutions including CCTV security and core network infrastructure, electrical and civil engineering works, ICT services, and low current systems. They also distribute products such as fiber optic cables, IoT M2M solutions with accompanying SIM cards, fiber-to-the-home connectivity materials, diverse networking products, and optical distribution and transport network equipment. These solutions are deployed in communication, electricity, and water projects for governmental, semi-governmental, and private entities. Furthermore, Keir International offers specialized engineering services covering planning, design, and inventory management for telecommunications, electrical systems, gas infrastructure, and water networks. Their extensive operation and maintenance services comprise spare parts management, training, routine and preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, network route patrolling, back-office support, project management and design, planning, procurement and logistics, network and element handover, and comprehensive KPI reporting.

name: Saudi Networkers Services Company
summary: Saudi Networkers Services Company, based in Saudi Arabia, specializes in providing diverse information and communication technology (ICT) services for businesses. Their comprehensive portfolio includes business process outsourcing, permanent staffing arrangements, managed service provisions, flexible modular solutions, and strategic consulting. The company caters to a broad spectrum of industries, including telecommunications, information technology, cybersecurity, banking, general consulting, utilities, and numerous other sectors. Saudi Networkers Services Company was founded in 2001 and maintains its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Future Care Trading Co.
summary: Operating within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Future Care Trading Co. specializes in providing a wide spectrum of home healthcare and laboratory services. Its service portfolio includes professional nursing care, physiotherapy, social assistance, and nutritional and dietary guidance, in addition to supplying nursing aides and arranging physician appointments. The company, founded in Jeddah in 2015, maintains its operational base there.

name: International Human Resources Company
summary: Operating within Saudi Arabia, International Human Resources Co. offers comprehensive outsourced solutions for both human resources and employment requirements. Its wide array of services includes external operational management, talent acquisition (encompassing general recruitment and attracting senior leaders), implementation of human resource management systems, a centralized employment platform, strategic HR advisory, staff performance evaluation, and bespoke personnel development programs. The company primarily serves a diverse clientele that includes banks, financial corporations, and both government and semi-government bodies. Established in 2005, its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Naba Alsaha Medical Services Company
summary: Naba Alsaha Medical Services Company is responsible for the administration and operation of Al-Zahraa General Hospital, located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The firm provides an extensive range of healthcare services, including outpatient consultations, inpatient treatment, and surgical procedures. Additionally, it manages an on-site pharmacy. Established in 1984, the company maintains its primary base of operations in Qatif, within Saudi Arabia.

name: Rawasi Albina Investment Co.
summary: Rawasi Albina Investment Co., operating from its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, specializes in providing crucial infrastructure solutions for the nation's telecommunications, energy, and water industries. The firm's extensive service portfolio encompasses the development, relocation, and dismantling of new GSM civil sites, as well as the installation of In-Building Solutions (IBS) and the deployment of Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) and Outside Plant (OSP) networks. Furthermore, the company undertakes various power projects, offers comprehensive operation and maintenance, executes telecommunications system implementations, and manages rehabilitation initiatives. Rawasi Albina also acts as a supplier of essential materials for these projects. Established in 2008, it has grown to be a key player in Saudi Arabia's infrastructure development.

name: Arabian Plastic Industrial Company Limited
summary: Arabian Plastic Industrial Co. Ltd. engages in the provision of injection molding production services, as well as extrusion of films, blow molding and thermoforming disposable products. Its activities include the production of plastic in its primary forms, plastic cans, boxes, bottles & bags, and wholesale of primary plastics, rubber and synthetic fibers. The company was founded on January 27, 1993 and is headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Abdulaziz and Mansour Ibrahim Albabtin Co.
summary: Abdulaziz and Mansour Ibrahim Albabtain Co. (AMBC) operates as a prominent wholesale distributor within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, focusing on a comprehensive array of food and beverage ingredients essential for the production of pastries, baked goods, and ice cream. The company's extensive product line for ice cream manufacturers features foundational elements such as soft ice cream bases, gelato products, and powder mixes for ice cream biscuits. It also includes ready-to-serve options like stick ice creams, mini cones, frozen yogurt, and all-inclusive kits. For pastry chefs and businesses, AMBC supplies a broad spectrum of necessities, including versatile pre-mixes, a wide selection of chocolate and fruit fillings and toppings, ripple sauces, decorative glazes, and both dried and candied fruits. Further offerings in this category encompass powder cream, caramelized grain and biscuit powders, margarine, whipping cream, various chocolates, and sugar pastes. The inventory also extends to vibrant liquid and jelly food colorings, specialized and classic flavor pastes, concentrated fruit pastes, sugar-free cream fillings and toppings, and proprietary AMBC trays. Within its bakery division, the company provides crucial components for bakers, such as dry yeast, dough improvers, diverse bread mixes, various seeds, and high-quality flours. Additionally, AMBC diversifies its portfolio with other specialties, including premium coffee ingredients, an assortment of lactose-free milk flavorings, mojito and squeeze product concentrates, smoothie bases, a wide range of syrups, and milkshake foundations. Established in 1998, Abdulaziz and Mansour Ibrahim Albabtain Co. maintains its corporate headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Sure Global Tech Company
summary: Sure Global Tech Company's core activities involve the wholesale and retail trade of computers and associated accessories, such as printers and their ink. The company also specializes in custom software development, covering systems analysis, design, and programming. Additionally, it offers strategic consulting services to senior management.

name: Knowledge Tower Trading Co.
summary: Knowledge Tower engages in the sale and distribution of books, and office and educational tools in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It markets and sells educational books to schools, universities, training institutes, and governmental educational institutions; provides digital curricula for private and international schools and universities; and operates e-learning platforms. It offers stationery, office supplies, newspapers, magazines, libraries, dictionaries, atlases, and maps. The company also provides educational programs for schools; educational resources for training; assessment, library, exams and certificate, and book fair services. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Saudi Top Trading Co.
summary: Saudi Top Trading Co. operates within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, specializing in the production and distribution of various plastic raw materials. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses polyethylene wax, polyethylene, polyethylene terephthalate, thermoplastic elastomers, styrenics, polypropylene, rubber, and engineering polymers, in addition to plastic films and bags. These materials are integral to numerous sectors, finding applications in adhesives, road marking paints, masterbatch and filler masterbatch, petroleum wax blends, PVC and PVC compounds, rubber manufacturing, and printing ink industries. Established in 2006, the firm maintains its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Molan Steel Company
summary: Molan Steel Co. engages in supplying steel products. It specializes in the production and supply of high-quality steel and steel trade in Saudi Arabia & abroad, The company was founded on August 6, 2015 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Leen Alkhair Trading Company
summary: Leen Alkhair Trading Company is an enterprise primarily focused on the agricultural sector within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company specializes in the cultivation, production, and distribution of fresh produce, encompassing a variety of vegetables and fruits. Its operational base and main offices are situated in Riyadh.

name: Edarat Communication and Information Technology Co.
summary: Operating throughout the Middle East and Gulf regions, Edarat Communication and Information Technology Co. is a leading provider of technology services. The firm delivers a comprehensive suite of solutions, which includes strategic advisory, data center engineering, advanced smart city and building technologies, seamless workload migration, and robust cloud services. Edarat caters to a varied client base, serving governmental entities, telecommunications providers, financial institutions, and both large and medium-sized businesses. The company was founded in 2004 and has its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Alqemam for Computer Systems Co.
summary: Alqemam for Computer Systems Co. provides software solutions in the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia. It offers qemam Decision Support, a digital statistic platform; qemam Digital Archiving platform for archiving documents and converting them into digital records; Building Maintenance System, a digital system for managing building and related services; and qemam Correspondence Management System, a transaction management system for government and private entities. The company also provides qemam GEOhub, a platform for tracking geographical projects; qemam Correspondence Link platform, a unified solution that connects entities with government or external bodies for exchange of correspondences and transactions; qemam ITSM platform for managing IT services within the organization; qemam Projects Monitoring Office, a platform for real-time monitoring of various entity’s projects; and qemam Attendance Mobile Application by Location, an mobile application linked to the geographic location to record fingerprints and manage attendance and departure. Further, it offers qemam Digital Identity platform that enables organizations to create websites and digital platforms; qemam For Coorprate Communication, a platform to support employees and provide organizational assistance; qemam Data and Indicators platform; qemam Data Link platform for secure and encrypted data sharing between various governmental systems; qemam GEO Exchange for sending and receiving geographical information between various entities; qemam Digital Partnerships Management platform; qemam GEO-Portal, a platform that provides access to various geographical information; qemam Welcome Services; qemam Statistical Digital platform; qemam Event Management, a platform for managing and launching events; and qemam Digital Services, a platform for creating, developing, and launching digital services. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Unaizah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Balady Poultry Trading Co.
summary: Balady Poultry Trading Co. is a Saudi Arabian enterprise dedicated to the production of various poultry items. Its extensive product portfolio features a wide array of chicken options, including whole birds (both plain and pre-marinated) and individual cuts such as breasts, thighs, wings, gizzards, hearts, livers, feet, and fillets. Beyond product manufacturing, the company also operates its own abattoirs, which are utilized for the slaughter and processing of poultry, rabbit, and other bird meats. Established in 2007, the company's operations are headquartered in Khamis Mushait, Saudi Arabia.

name: Waja Company
summary: Waja Company operates as a diversified enterprise with core activities spanning the construction, media and communication, and information technology sectors. In its construction arm, the firm acts as a contractor and real estate developer, managing and executing a wide array of building and restoration projects. The company's media and communication segment provides advertising campaign services, alongside the manufacturing of various signage including indoor, outdoor, marketing, and traffic signboards. Furthermore, its information technology offerings encompass software development, expert consultation, big data solutions, network services, and other associated technical support. Waja Company is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Knowledge Net Company
summary: Knowledge Network Computer Co. Ltd. operates as a software development company. It is involved in the wholesale of computers and their accessories, including the sale of printers and their inks. The company was founded on May 23, 1921 and is headquartered in Riyadh, South Africa.

name: Horizon Food Company
summary: Horizon Food Company Limited engages in the cutting, processing, packaging, and wrapping of meat and poultry in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers chilled and frozen poultry, rabbits, birds, and meat, as well as sausages and hamburgers. It also provides meat shawarma, chicken shawarma, and doner kabab under the Iskender brand name. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Dammam, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Meyar Company
summary: Established in 1960, Meyar Company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse range of cement-based products. Its offerings encompass ready-mix concrete, essential construction raw materials, interlock pavers, bardora, and concrete blocks.

name: Saudi Lime Industries Co.
summary: Saudi Lime Industries Co. is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of a broad spectrum of limestone-derived products. Its comprehensive inventory includes raw limestone, dolomite, quicklime, both standard and dolomitic hydrated lime, powdered quicklime, calcium carbonate, and building materials such as lime sand bricks, blocks, and various types of bricks. These essential products cater to numerous industrial applications, including steel and iron production, glass manufacturing, mining, agriculture, food processing, environmental and water treatment, general construction, pulp and paper production, and the oil and gas sector. Established in 1977, the company's main operations are directed from its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Ghida Al-Sultan Company
summary: Ghida Al-Sultan Company operates a fast-food and franchising business across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its menu features burgers, sold under the "Sultan Delight Burger" and "Fuel burger" brand names, alongside various pizzas. The enterprise was founded in 2004 and maintains its headquarters in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Mayar Holding Co.
summary: Mayar Holding Co., founded in 1999 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focuses on the manufacturing, sale, installation, and servicing of elevators, escalators, and their components within the Kingdom. The company operates across three primary business segments: Elevators and Escalators, Feed and Agriculture, and Plastic. Beyond its core vertical transport activities, Mayar Holding also supplies feed products for poultry and various livestock. Its plastics division produces a diverse array of items, including plastic for drip irrigation systems, semi-finished plastic compounds, PVC compounds, EVA materials, and footwear like shoes and sandals. Additionally, the company is involved in the commercial trade of irrigation systems. Mayar Holding Co. was formerly known as Gulf Elevators and Escalators Company Ltd.

name: Almuneef Company for Trade, Industry, Agriculture and Contracting
summary: AlMuneef Company for Trade, Industry, Agriculture and Contracting operates within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, focusing on the procurement and provision of agricultural necessities, including seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and a variety of farm supplies. Its product range is accessible to customers through both traditional retail stores and a dedicated online platform. Established in 2009, the firm's main administrative offices are situated in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Tam Development Co.
summary: Tam Development LLC is a Saudi Arabian-based consultancy specializing in management and digital solutions. The firm offers a comprehensive range of advisory services, including strategic development, guidance on business transformation, innovation and design methodologies, public engagement, change management, accelerated execution strategies, financial oversight, large-scale talent development, and establishing organizational and functional frameworks. In addition to its core consulting, the company actively engages in marketing and advertising campaigns, public relations and communications, supports new ventures through incubator and accelerator programs, and provides marketing services for external entities. It caters to a diverse client base across industries such as tourism, culture, education, entertainment, healthcare, and various business sectors. Established in 2012, Tam Development LLC is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Munawla Cargo Co. Ltd.
summary: Munawla Cargo Co. Ltd. is a prominent provider of comprehensive logistics services, operating throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its extensive suite of offerings covers a wide array of solutions, including specialized project logistics, efficient freight forwarding, terminal operations management, diverse transportation options (including air freight), warehousing and distribution, and dedicated shipping agency services. Established in 1997, the company maintains its headquarters in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al-Razi Medical Co.
summary: Established in 1986 and based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, Al-Razi Medical Company functions as a principal distributor of a broad range of medical equipment throughout the Kingdom. Their extensive product catalog encompasses essentials like hospital beds, steam and suction devices, inhalation apparatus, various masks (including oxygen masks), needles, water bladders, bandages, gloves, and ear piercing provisions. The company caters to a diverse clientele within the healthcare sector, serving hospitals, clinics, medical centers, other medical enterprises, and pharmacies.

name: Professional Medical Expertise Co.
summary: Professional Medical Expertise Company engages in the retail sale of medical equipment, tools, supplies, and medical devices in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. It offers products related to spine, sports medicine, pediatric orthopedic, general surgery, infection prevention, oncology, gastrointestinal, endoscopy, bariatric surgery, women's health, critical care, and diabetes, as well as dental care unit. The company is also involved in the medical devices warehouse activities; legal representation of medical products and devices manufacturers; the sale of medicines and drug warehouse activities; and medical, surgical, equipment, and instruments trading activities. In addition, it sells and installs medical equipment and supplies to private and public hospitals, and medical centers. The company was formerly known as Socrates Specialized Trading Company and changed its name to Professional Medical Expertise Company in July 2012. Professional Medical Expertise Company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Marble Design Co.
summary: Founded in 2007, Marble Design Factory Company operates within the natural marble industry across Saudi Arabia, with its primary office situated in Riyadh.

name: Paper Home Co.
summary: Paper Home Co., headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, specializes in the manufacturing and sale of corrugated cardboard products across the Kingdom. Its extensive product portfolio includes point-of-sale (POS) displays, custom die-cut boxes, wrap-around packaging, various trays, regular slotted containers, jumbo boxes, half-slotted containers, mill run sheets, and protective dividers and pads. The company also offers corrugated flutes in C, B, E, BC, and BE profiles. Paper Home Co. serves a diverse range of industries, such as poultry, industrial materials, fashion, delivery services, retail, and bottled water producers.

name: Dar Almarkabah for Renting Cars Co.
summary: Founded in 2009, DAR ALMARKABAH For Renting Cars Company offers vehicle rental solutions throughout Saudi Arabia. This Riyadh-based enterprise specializes in providing a suite of services such as intercity transport, airport connectivity, and exclusive limousine options.

name: Atlas Elevators General Trading and Contracting Co.
summary: Headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Atlas Elevators General Trading & Contracting Co. provides comprehensive services for vertical transportation systems. The company specializes in the procurement, distribution, installation, and ongoing maintenance of both electric and hydraulic elevators and escalators, serving clients throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and on an international scale.

name: Rimath Hospitality Company
summary: Headquartered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and established in 1925, Intelligent Oud Co. is a company dedicated to the formulation, manufacturing, and supply of incenses, perfumes, and cosmetics. These diverse product lines are distributed across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Italy, primarily trading under the iOud, O'SO, and Thannah labels.

name: Al Rashid Industrial Co.
summary: Al Rashid Industrial Co. specializes in the manufacturing and sale of diverse plastic and packaging solutions, catering to both government entities and commercial clients across Saudi Arabia. Their extensive product range encompasses food storage containers for refrigerators, various trays, Cassatt, and jakes, alongside specialized medical packages and containers. The company also produces packaging boxes tailored for a wide array of goods, including cosmetic and personal care items, saffron, incense, Maamoul, dates, sweets, and citrus products. Furthermore, Al Rashid provides numerous single-use packaging options, such as heatable and transparent cans, distinct boxes for sushi, cakes, egg storage, and fruits, as well as general-purpose cake cans. All products are available for purchase via their online platform. Founded in 1969, the company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Clean life company
summary: Clean Life Company, together with its subsidiary, provides general building cleaning services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers building cleaning services, including chimneys and windows; external building; swimming pool cleaning and maintenance; and disinfection and fumigation activities to exterminate insects and rodents. It also provides furniture cleaning, rehabilitation cleaning, pest control, home maintenance, furniture moving, hourly cleaning, car wash, and air conditioner cleaning services. In addition, the company is involved in general construction of residential and government buildings; construction of airports and their facilities; construction of prefabricated buildings on sites; and renovations of residential and non-residential buildings. Clean Life Company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: United Mining Industries Company
summary: United Mining Industries Company manufactures and sells a range of gypsum products for residential and commercial development in Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Gypsum Board & Powder, Cement Board, and Others segments. It offers gypsum and performance boards; fiber cement boards; gypsum and fiber cement board ceiling tiles; metal profiles and accessories for walls and ceilings; T-grid ceiling systems; and gypsum powder. United Mining Industries Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Riyal Investment and Development Co.
summary: Riyal Investment & Development Co. primarily operates in the sectors of vehicle rental and diverse commercial trading. The firm's activities are organized into dedicated segments for the sale and lease of automobiles. This enterprise, with its headquarters in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, was established on February 9, 1993.

name: Mulkia Investment Company
summary: Mulkia Investment Company is a company listed on the Saudi Arabian Stock Exchange under the ticker 9585. It operates in the Capital Markets industry within the Financials sector. The company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Osool and Bakheet Investment Co.
summary: Osool & Bakheet Investment Co. is a financial institution primarily engaged in brokerage and asset management activities. The firm offers a range of services, acting both as a principal and an agent, including the administration of investment funds, personalized portfolio management, and asset custody. It was established on January 1, 2005, and its headquarters are situated in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Lana Medical Co.
summary: Lana Medical Co. primarily focuses on the production of medical equipment. Beyond manufacturing, their extensive services also include the supply of medical consumables, effective healthcare waste management, professional maintenance for medical apparatus, and comprehensive infection prevention strategies. This enterprise was established in 2010, with its central operations based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Riyadh Steel Co.
summary: Riyadh Steel Company is primarily involved in the fabrication of steel products and the commercialization of steel scrap. Its diverse portfolio encompasses items such as flat bars, angle bars, billets, and sheared scrap. Founded on April 19, 2000, the company maintains its principal operational base in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Fad International Company
summary: Fad International Company specializes in the retail and wholesale of women's dresses and related accessories, prominently featuring its Vivid Flair London and Femi9 brands. Expanding its product line, the company also trades in general clothing, textiles, bags, suitcases, shoes and their accessories, leather goods, a variety of artificial and natural perfumes, cosmetics, makeup, lotions, and eyewear for men, women, and children. Customers can purchase these items through the company's physical stores and its online e-commerce platform. Established in 1999, Fad International's operations extend across the GCC and wider Middle East, including key markets such as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, and Egypt. The firm is headquartered in Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: View United Real Estate Development Co.
summary: View United Real Estate Development Co. specializes in the creation and sale of contemporary, innovative, and premium real estate properties. Its portfolio encompasses developments such as View 12, View 13 Lite, View 13 Server, View 9 River, View 10, and View 9 Sky. Ahmed bin Bajad bin Thabit founded the company on June 15, 2011, and its primary operations are based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Almujtama Alraida Medical Co.
summary: Almujtama Alraida Medical Co. delivers a variety of healthcare services. The company specializes in the retail of pharmaceuticals, medical products, cosmetics, and toiletries, offering these items through its dedicated network of stores, which encompass outlets for medical devices, beauty products, and pharmaceutical goods. Furthermore, its operational scope includes pharmaceutical laboratories. Established in 2001 by Abdulaziz Omar Yousef Khoja, the entity is headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Pan Gulf Marketing Co.
summary: Pan Gulf Marketing Company is a leading distributor specializing in stationery and office supplies, serving a vast international market that spans the Middle East, Africa, and the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS). Its comprehensive product portfolio caters to a wide range of needs, from office and school essentials to artistic and crafting pursuits. Offerings include various writing instruments (such as pens, pencils, highlighters, and POSCA markers), paper products (notebooks, notepads, copy paper, sticky notes), art and craft materials (easels, canvases, brushes, coloring supplies, and general art accessories), essential office consumables (adhesives, tapes, blades, cutters, labelling products, filing solutions), and other items like hydration products and office bags. The company proudly distributes merchandise from a diverse array of respected brands, including ALKHATAT, ATLAS, Ayman, CARL, CLIPP, Conda, Daler Rowney, DC Fix, Fantastick, FIMO, Foldermate, Formtec, FUJIPLA, Helix, Kiddy Clay, Leeho, Lefranc & Bourgeois, Maped, Marie, Maruman, Max, Miquelrius, Moleskine, Olfa, Pentel, Pidilite, Rapid, RENZ, SDI, STAEDTLER, and Uniball. Founded in 1964, Pan Gulf Marketing Company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al-Modawat Specialized Medical Co.
summary: Al-Modawat Specialized Medical Company, with its headquarters located in Muhayil, Saudi Arabia, operates a comprehensive healthcare facility in the southern Aseer region of the country.

name: WSM for Information Technology
summary: WSM For Information Technology offers information technology services to customers in the governmental and private sectors in Saudi Arabia. The company offers operating systems, systems analysis, software design and programming, information systems, data science and analysis, and cloud computing services. It also engages in establishing the infrastructure for hosting websites on the network, data processing services, and related activities; and research and development in market research and opinion polls. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Quara Finance Co.
summary: Quara Finance Co. is a financial services provider operating across Saudi Arabia, primarily delivering its solutions via a digital platform. The company offers a diverse portfolio of services, including lease financing, consumer lending, and funding options for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Founded in 2009, the Riyadh-based firm was formerly known as Maalem Financing Company before officially adopting the name Quara Finance Company on January 14, 2021.

name: Leaf Global Environmental Services Co.
summary: Leaf Global Environmental Services specializes in environmental engineering and technological solutions. The firm delivers a range of services, including environmental and social impact evaluations, hazardous substance inspections, continuous monitoring of noise and vibrations, mangrove ecosystem relocation, and habitat restoration.

name: Al Mohafaza Company for Education
summary: Al Mohafaza Company for Education provides education services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers preschool, kindergarten, primary, intermediate, and secondary education for male and female students, as well as managing educational complexes.

name: Taqat Mineral Trading Co.
summary: Established in 2017, Taqat Mineral Trading Co. is a Saudi Arabian enterprise dedicated to the acquisition and repurposing of metallic materials. With its headquarters situated in Riyadh, the company's offerings specifically include iron ore and aluminum.

name: Qomel Company Limited
summary: Qomel Co. is a healthcare company, which engages in the provision of comprehensive and distinguished medical services that meet patients’ needs in an efficient and reliable manner. The firm is also involved in providing pharmaceutical services and medical supplies. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Mohammed Hadi Al-Rasheed Company
summary: Mohammed Hadi Al-Rasheed Co. engages in the provision of mining industries products, as well as military, general maintenance, and contracting services. It also offers industrial silica sand, granite and marble stone, gravel and asphalt products. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Yaqeen Capital Co.
summary: Yaqeen Capital Company, founded in 2006 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operates as a diversified financial services provider within the Kingdom. Its core business revolves around asset management, investment banking, brokerage, and custodial services. The company organizes its activities into four primary divisions: Brokerage, Investment Banking Group, Asset Management, and Investments. It specializes in facilitating, advising on, and executing transactions involving securities, alongside offering secure safekeeping services for these assets. Moreover, Yaqeen Capital offers a comprehensive suite of advisory services and investment products. These include guidance on initial public offerings (IPOs), rights issues, various forms of debt and financial restructuring, general corporate strategy, private placements, buy-side advisory, and mergers and acquisitions (M&A). The firm also actively manages mutual funds and client portfolios, provides dynamic portfolio management and trading support, and delivers valuable research insights.

name: Horizon Educational Co.
summary: Horizon Educational Company provides education services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers preschool, kindergarten, primary, intermediate, and secondary education; and provides educational transportation. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Miral Dental Clinics Co.
summary: Miral Dental Clinics Co. is a company that engages in the provision of dental, treatment, and cosmetic services. The company operates through its two branches in Riyadh. The company was founded on September 3, 2002 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Neft Alsharq For Chemical Industry Company
summary: Neft Alsharq For Chemical Industry Company manufactures and sells industrial oils, greases, and engine fluids. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Altharwah Albashariyyah Co.
summary: Altharwah Albashariyyah Co. engages in management consulting, training and development services, as well as artificial intelligence and digital solutions in Saudi Arabia. The company offers talent assessment, professional human resources services, human capital advisory services, talent management, culture transformation, people growth and capability building, and technology and AI advisory services. It also provides systems analysis, user interface and experience design, application development, and artificial intelligence technologies; rehabilitating and restructuring administrative, financial, and operational processes for establishments; and advanced management consulting services. Additionally, the company engages in organizing and managing exhibitions and conferences, higher education institutes, language teaching institutes, conversation skills training institutes, training centres, mediating Saudi employment, and operating temporary employment agencies for Saudis; and e-learning solutions. Altharwah Albashariyyah Co. was founded in 2012 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: ASG Plastic Factory Co.
summary: ASG Plastic Factory Co. specializes in the production of a wide variety of plastic goods. Their extensive product line includes plastic packaging solutions, storage jars, tableware, bags, food preservation containers, household items, kitchenware, and single-use decorative pieces. The company was established on February 7, 2005, and operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Ashghal Al Moysra Co.
summary: Al Ashghal Al Moysra Co. engages in the construction business in Saudi Arabia. It engages in construction and renovation of government buildings, prefabricated buildings on-site, and residential and non-residential buildings; construction of roads, streets, sidewalks, and road accessories; operation of sewage treatment networks and facilities; repairs and maintenance services; cleaning services; water transport and distribution; collection and transport of sewage; and ground handling services. The company also engages in transport and logistics services, including dry and cold transport; loading and unloading of goods and passenger baggage; and freight forwarding. In addition, the company offers tempered glass solutions for doors, facades, interior partitions, and windows; medical vinyl flooring solutions; manufacture and installation of metal structures, canopies, fences, and railings; and engages in design, supply, installation, and maintenance of air conditioning and refrigeration systems. Al Ashghal Al Moysra Co. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Sakaka, Saudi Arabia.

name: Nass Petrol Factory Company
summary: Naas Petrol Factory Co. engages in the specialization in the production of petroleum derivatives. The firm produces different types of mechanical and hydraulic oils, lubricants, and distilled water for all types of engines. Its products include gear oil, hydraulic oils, gasoline engine oils, diesel engine oils, and automatic transmission oils. The company is headquartered on November 10, 2010 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: First Avenue for Real Estate De
summary: First Avenue Real Estate Development Co. specializes in the acquisition, development, and ongoing management of various property ventures. Its portfolio of developments is situated across the cities of Jeddah, Riyadh, and Madina. This firm was established on August 24, 2017, and conducts its central operations from its head office located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabian United Float Glass Company
summary: Arabian United Float Glass Company manufactures and sells glass products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers float and pattern glass products, and mirrors. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Sama Healthy Water Factory Co.
summary: Sama Healthy Water Factory Co. specializes in the creation of potable water and ice products. The firm was established on July 4, 2008, and its principal operations are based in Jazan, Saudi Arabia.

name: Shalfa Facilities Management Company
summary: Shalfa Facilities Management Company provides facility management solutions and municipal services in Saudi Arabia. The company offers operation and maintenance services for the public and private sectors; and facility management services, such as help desk, concierge, operation and maintenance, janitorial, pest control, gardening, waste management, health and safety, space allocation and changes, and hospitality. It also provides security and firefighting services; and environmental services, including waste management projects, sludge handling, and other types of hazardous waste. In addition, the company undertakes general construction and infrastructure works comprising construction and maintenance of roads, bridges, tunnels, water and sewage networks, and pumping stations. Shalfa Facilities Management Company was founded in 1981 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Purity for Information Technology Company
summary: Purity for Information Technology Company, established in 2012 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, provides an extensive portfolio of IT and digital solutions. The company's offerings encompass a broad spectrum of IT infrastructure services, including Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), comprehensive cloud management, monitoring, optimization, public cloud migration, and disaster recovery and backup services. They also deliver vital IT enterprise solutions such as servers, storage, networking, load balancers, virtualization, backup, and VDI, alongside CCTV and UPS systems. Further, Purity specializes in business applications managed services, covering data visualization, reporting, data warehousing, and BigData solutions, in addition to application development and consulting. The company supplies a wide array of end-user solutions, from laptops, PCs, workstations, thin client devices, and Apple products to printers, displays, projectors, handheld devices, and software licenses. Beyond these core areas, Purity Tech Co also focuses on digital transformation, cybersecurity solutions, professional and information management, and a variety of managed and support services.

name: Mufeed Company
summary: Mufeed Company engages in the event management business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It invests in, plans, manages, and implements exhibitions and conferences; television programs; the production of television commercials; television broadcasting; and television-related activities. The company is also involved in booking and selling tickets for sports and entertainment events. In addition, its activities include advertising and publicity services, technical services, and leasing film production equipment. Further, the company provides media production, digital marketing, and supporting services. It serves public and private sectors. Mufeed Company was founded in 2008 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Arabica Star Co.
summary: Arabica Star Company specializes in developing and managing coffee shop establishments throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, all operating under its proprietary Arabica Star brand. These venues offer patrons a diverse selection of food items, in addition to a wide array of hot, chilled, and frozen beverages. The firm was established in 2008 and maintains its headquarters in Buraydah, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al-Fakhera Men's Tailoring Company
summary: Al-Fakhera Men's Tailoring Company specializes in crafting and selling custom-fitted attire for both men and children. Beyond its bespoke offerings, the company also provides a wide array of ready-to-wear garments for men and children, along with various complementary accessories, including rings, slippers, walking sticks, and underwear. Customers can conveniently purchase its products through its online retail channel. The enterprise was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Riyadh, located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Multi Business Group Co.
summary: Multi Business Group Co. is officially authorized for a broad spectrum of activities, encompassing construction, manufacturing industries, transportation and storage, wholesale and retail commerce, and the maintenance of motor vehicles and motorcycles, as stipulated by its commercial register. Its articles of association further broaden this mandate to include real estate operations, in addition to the aforementioned sectors. Presently, the company's primary focus is on delivering specialized design and construction contracting services for architectural finishes, interior decoration, and the electrical and mechanical engineering systems within buildings. Furthermore, it is actively involved in the retail distribution of a diverse range of products, including building materials, electrical components, plumbing supplies, and various finishing products for construction projects.

name: Balsm Alofoq Medical Co.
summary: In addition to selling medical provisions, Balsm Alofoq Medical delivers a variety of dental care, encompassing both curative and beautifying services.

name: Digital Research Company
summary: Digital Research Company excels in providing market intelligence and sophisticated data analysis. Their expertise spans various critical business areas, from advising on brand and communications strategies and managing corporate reputation, to performing advanced analytics and enabling data monetization. They also develop business intelligence platforms, enhance sales and customer relations, guide organizational transformation, and offer specialized economic advisory services.

name: Shmoh Almadi Co.
summary: Shmoh Almadi Company engages in the production and sale of sweets and pastries in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers a range of maamoul, kleja, cake, wafer, oat fingers, rings oat biscuit, cream fudge, chocolate fingers, dates, and frozen desserts. It sells its products under the Past Candles, Mama’s Maamoul, Luli Art, Ataib Najd Food, Past Candles, Umm Saleh Sweets, Mila Sweets, and Moody. The company also sells its products through online. Shmoh Almadi Company was founded in 2006 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Albattal Factory for Chemical Industries Co.
summary: Albattal Factory for Chemical Industries Co. is a leading specialist in the manufacturing and marketing of high-grade cellulose ether products, such as Polyanionic Cellulose (PAC) and Carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC). Notably, it is recognized as the inaugural production facility for these particular compounds within the GCC.

name: Alshehili Company for metal industries
summary: Established in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in 2005, Alshehili Company for metal industries is a prominent firm specializing in the design, production, and distribution of a comprehensive array of logistics and defense equipment. For the logistics sector, the company offers a diverse portfolio of freight vehicles. This includes various trailer types such as refrigerated, dry cargo, curtain side, high side, flatbed, low bed, double-deck car, and utility trailers. They also manufacture tanker trucks and trailers, boom trucks, block cranes, and heavy-duty construction equipment like tipper dump trailers/trucks, concrete mixers, and concrete pumps. Specialized transport solutions feature horse transporters, mobile homes, and mobile clinics. Their offerings further extend to a wide range of trucks (e.g., dry cargo box, refrigerated box, sliding door, curtain type, icebox side door, fixed body car recovery, mobile workshop, and dianna models), armored cash-carrying SUVs and vans, as well as insulated refrigerated and dry cargo vans and pick-ups. Complementary products include shelters, cold storage units, cooling systems, chassis, tail lifts, concrete block grapples, and windscreen-glasses. In the defense arena, Alshehili manufactures robust armored solutions such as shield turret pickups, heavy machinery, troop carriers, specialized project vehicles, and mobile shooting ranges. They also provide armored glass and comprehensive vehicle armoring products. Beyond manufacturing, the company delivers extensive maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services. These encompass repairs for various components like underfloors, outer edges, walls, doors, chassis, axles, roofs, and paintwork, along with complete refurbishing overhauls. Alshehili serves a broad clientele, including numerous commercial organizations and governmental institutions throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

name: Itmam Consultancy Co.
summary: Itmam Consultancy Co. specializes in providing sophisticated management advisory services to a diverse clientele, encompassing public, semi-governmental, private, and non-profit entities. The company's core mission involves aiding clients in navigating strategic and operational transformation initiatives, while also focusing on the evaluation and enhancement of compliance frameworks. Additionally, Itmam supports the development of robust organizational capabilities.

name: Basma Adeem Medical Co.
summary: Basma Adeem Medical Co. specializes in delivering a broad spectrum of dental and dermatological services. Their extensive medical offerings encompass various procedures, including outpatient (one-day) surgery, orthodontic treatments, and advanced maxillofacial surgery. Within dentistry, they provide periodontal surgery, dental implants, root canal therapy (endodontics), general oral and dental health services, and a wide array of restorative, cosmetic, and prosthodontic dental solutions, alongside dedicated pediatric dentistry. Additionally, the company offers comprehensive dermatology and laser treatments. Founded on November 13, 2012, its operations are headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Twareat Medical Care Co.
summary: Twareat Medical Care Company delivers healthcare services primarily to remote and industrial regions throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company also operates Twareat Medical Center, situated in Jubail City, which hosts a variety of specialized clinics including internal medicine, pediatrics, obstetrics and gynecology, ENT, general medicine, and emergency care. Complementing these services, the Center offers radiology and medical examination facilities.

name: Lamasat Co.
summary: Lamasat Company operates a chain of beauty salons in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company also offers cosmetic supplies. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Medina, Saudi Arabia.

name: Ratio Speciality Company for Trading
summary: Within the restaurant and cafe industry, Ratio Specialty Company provides crucial services in both franchise development and supply chain oversight.

name: Hedab Alkhaleej Trading Co.
summary: Hedab Alkhaleej Trading Co. operates as a versatile enterprise, providing a diverse portfolio of services. Its business activities encompass construction projects, vehicle servicing, the distribution of fuel, retail sales of hardware, and comprehensive logistics solutions including freight transport and cargo management, alongside real estate operations.

name: Future Vision for Health Traini
summary: Future Vision for Health Training, an Al Madinah-based company established in 2019, specializes in delivering professional development and educational programs across Saudi Arabia. The firm provides a diverse range of courses available through online, in-person, live virtual, and blended learning models.
