Its curriculum encompasses critical areas such as AHA, SHA, essential soft skills, podcast production, and general healthcare education. Beyond its core training offerings, Future Vision extends its services to include organizing medical and educational events, managing marketing initiatives, conducting post-program evaluations, and supplying comprehensive registration and technical assistance for its programs. The company also assists with the design and printing of course materials, actively bids on government contracts, and offers media creation services, including photography and videography. Future Vision caters to a broad audience, including healthcare professionals and students, high school, diploma, and university graduates, as well as employees from the public, private, and military sectors.

name: Adeer Real Estate Co.
summary: Established in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, in 2012, Adeer Real Estate Company delivers comprehensive real estate marketing services to a wide array of clients, including private individuals, corporate entities, and institutions, across the Saudi Arabian market. Beyond marketing, its offerings extend to property management and sales, as well as providing specialized real estate consulting and detailed market research. The company operates as a subsidiary of Sumou International Investment Company.

name: Dkhoun National Trading Co.
summary: Dkhoun National Trading Company specializes in the creation and global distribution of Arabic fragrances, reaching customers both within Saudi Arabia and internationally. Operating under its proprietary Dkhoun brand, the firm's diverse product portfolio features a range of body and hair perfumes, oud oils, traditional oud, and incense, which are sold through its digital e-commerce platforms and brick-and-mortar stores. The company's principal office is situated in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Al Kuzama Trading Co
summary: Established in 2013 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Al Kuzama Trading Co. specializes in the management and operation of a diverse portfolio of restaurants throughout the Kingdom. Its operations encompass several distinct dining establishments, including LAVASH, BEIT OMAR, OFFWHITE, Ovvi, ARMIN, KARAZAH, OFFWHITE Al-Khohbar, and mysore.

name: Axelerated Solutions for Inform
summary: Axelerated Solutions for Information and Communication Technology, an enterprise based in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, specializes in delivering a broad spectrum of IT services. Their comprehensive offerings encompass critical infrastructure solutions, such as data center establishment, migration assistance, and robust disaster recovery and business continuity planning. The firm also provides an extensive suite of cybersecurity measures, including identity and access management, privileged access control, mobile device oversight, data encryption, and seamless single sign-on with multi-factor authentication. Complementing these are their managed IT services and comprehensive system integration capabilities, particularly focusing on automation deployment. Catering to a diverse clientele, Axelerated Solutions serves sectors such as telecommunications, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, government, defense, and retail. The company commenced operations in 2015.

name: Anmat Technology for Trading Co
summary: Anmat Technology for Trading Co. engages in audio and visual studio services, providing fixed and mobile communication, internet, and cloud computing services. The company also offers systems analysis, custom software design, network management, and digital certification services. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Asas Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment Co.
summary: Asas Makeen Real Estate Development and Investment Co. primarily focuses on acquiring and enhancing real estate, which includes constructing and promoting residential properties, shopping centers, and professional office spaces. These undertakings are carried out on land that is either owned by the company itself or by external parties.

name: Hawyia Auctions Company
summary: Hawyia Auctions Company focuses on providing expert real estate marketing and property auction solutions. This firm, which began its operations in 2019, is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Time Entertainment Co
summary: Time Entertainment Co is a Riyadh-headquartered enterprise operating in the leisure and entertainment sector, known for promoting events and providing diverse services such as event management, advertising, and recreational activities.

name: Naf Company for Feed for Indust
summary: Naf Company for Feed for Industry specializes in manufacturing and supplying diverse compound feeds. These products are expertly formulated to fulfill the dietary requirements of livestock such as cattle, camels, and various poultry species. The company's offerings include specialized nutritional products for ruminants, poultry, and other avian animals. Established in 2017, this firm operates from its headquarters in Ar Rass, Saudi Arabia.

name: National Signage Industrial Co.
summary: Operating within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, National Signage Industrial Company specializes in the creation, production, installation, and retail of both promotional and navigational display solutions. Their extensive product portfolio includes a variety of signage such as road markers, safety warnings, site-specific project displays, advanced digital LED screens, printed advertisements, marketing banners, traffic indicators, vehicle registration plates, and exhibition setups. Beyond physical products, the firm also delivers a comprehensive suite of services, encompassing engineering expertise, detailed execution plans, three-dimensional design visualizations, repair and ongoing maintenance, technical assistance, post-purchase support, event and trade show booth construction, and interior design enhancements. Their clientele spans both public sector entities and private enterprises. Established in 2011, its headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, functioning as a division under the Engineer Holding Group.

name: Wajd life trading Company
summary: Wajd Life Trading Co., established in 2013 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is a prominent provider of medical and non-medical equipment and related supplies across the Kingdom. Their product portfolio encompasses various diagnostic and therapeutic devices, such as blood pressure monitors, thermometers, ultrasound systems, and electrocardiogram machines. Additionally, they furnish crucial spare parts, consumables, and accessories for medical devices, including protective gloves, masks, cables, batteries, display screens, and sensors. Beyond product provision, the company offers a suite of services, including operational management, preventative maintenance, repair work, and comprehensive facilities management, coupled with dedicated after-sales support. Their client base is diverse, serving commercial entities, healthcare organizations, and educational establishments.

name: Hamad Mohammed Bin Saedan Real Estate Company
summary: Hamad Mohammed Bin Saedan Real Estate Company is a prominent entity within the property sector, offering a full spectrum of integrated real estate projects and related services. Their extensive service array covers property development, asset management, real estate marketing and brokerage activities, alongside the management of real estate funds. Established in 1969, the firm operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Jamjoom Fashion Trading Company
summary: Jamjoom Fashion Trading Company specializes in the retail of fashion apparel and accessories. Its product portfolio encompasses lingerie, nightwear, and a range of ready-to-wear clothing, marketed under its distinct brands: Nayomi, Mihyar, and Dream. The company reaches its clientele through a combination of physical retail outlets and an online e-commerce platform. Established in 2023, this entity maintains its primary operations in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Furthermore, Jamjoom Fashion Trading Company operates as a subsidiary of Kamal Osman Jamjoom Trading LLC (KSA).

name: Sahat Almajd Trading Co.
summary: Sahat Almajd Trading Company specializes in the management and operation of coffee establishments. The firm markets its diverse range of products through proprietary brands such as Hanoverian, Braid, Suzam, and Spark. Founded in 2005, Sahat Almajd Trading Company's corporate headquarters are situated in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

name: Abdul Aziz Al-Tuwaijri Trading Company
summary: Abdul Aziz Al-Tuwaijri Trading Company specializes in the marketing and distribution of a comprehensive selection of consumer products. These offerings encompass food items, healthcare products for consumers, household cleaning agents, and personal hygiene goods. The company makes its merchandise accessible to customers via its online retail platforms. Established in 1957, the firm's primary operations are based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
